title: Help Desk Manager
description:
British High Commission is looking for a Helpdesk Manager who will be responsible for leading on the Estates Helpdesk for New Delhi and deliver comprehensive administrative support for the operations of the Estates department, this includes managing the Estates Technical supervisor’s response and supervising the work requests. It is the responsibility of the Helpdesk manager to review Estates requests everyday and remind technical team on necessary action required on each outstanding request and update changes every day. It involves preparing and presenting Management Information to Head of Estates Operations India and leading on all external communication from Delhi Estates. The role is designated as the central communication’s Hub lead role for all matters pertaining to Estates.

**Roles and responsibilities / what will the jobholder be expected to achieve:**

Leading on Estates Helpdesk Automations and Power BI- 30%

The jobholder will be responsible for managing day to day queries received at Helpdesk and ensuring the requests are prioritised, responded, and managed within the SLA. The Helpdesk Manager key responsibilities will include leading on Automation, Microsoft Flows and Power BI reports to manage the Helpdesk. You will be required to communicate effectively and answer complex queries with an aim to provide resolution within required SLA, this needs excellent communication and problem-solving skills.

A key responsibility includes ensuring the swift and successful completion of assigned works by coordinating with the technical team to prioritize tasks according to urgency, and to provide timely updates under varying circumstances.

You will be accountable for preparing management information related to Estates Helpdesk, Contracts and Inventories and submit it to Head of Estates Operations India every week for discussion and update. This also includes overseeing various projects ranging from immediate, short-term tasks to long-term strategic planning and the day-to-day management necessary to maintain optimal performance of the Estates. The jobholder is expected to stay informed of performance metrics trade-wise, location-wise, and concern-wise, providing thorough explanations for any variances or deviations in the monthly reports. The jobholder will also coordinate various Estate management audits and technical inspections, acting as the liaison for IT-related matters. Additional administrative duties may be assigned as needed to ensure the smooth and efficient functioning of departmental activities.

**Budget and Contract Management- 30%**

The Helpdesk Manager will lead on Budget and as Contract manager for few major Estates Contracts and will also lead on procurement of items necessary for purchase to resolve ongoing requests. You must liaise with stores to check the inventory is maintained and the stock is available for major area of concern/complaints. The incumbent will be responsible for managing contracts, identifying ways to increase efficiency and improve productivity, collecting and collating data for forecasting and planning purposes.

**Supervising and Team Management -20%**

The Jobholder will be responsible for organising the work loads of Technical Estates Supervisors and providing timely guidance and support they need to complete the jobs assigned to them, this includes monitoring the workflows on a timely basis. The Helpdesk manager must proactively raise issues and concerns with Head of Estates and escalate matters where necessary. The helpdesk manager should receive daily inputs from the supervisors and update response on the requests. You also be responsible for compiling and updating Estates preventive maintenance master data and ensuring that schedules are communicated and delivered on time. You will be responsible for mentoring and coaching Estates Supervisors on dealing with day-to-day Estates requests and projects. The Helpdesk manager is expected to share ideas and innovations to improve our approach to Estates Management.

**Communication and Team Management- 20%**

The Helpdesk Manager will be responsible for all communication from Delhi Estates that includes responses, weekly updates to staff, bulletin submissions, newsletters etc. You should make sure the external communication is timely managed. The role entails devising and executing an effective communication strategy to enhance outreach for the Estates, thereby ensuring a stronger focus on customer satisfaction.

**We will accept only online applications by
11 November 2026 (latest by 23:55 hours IST).**

title: D365 Functional Consultant
description:
**Role purpose:**

Provide hands-on D365 Finance & Operations functional support and delivery capability, helping the D365 Functional Lead maintain a stable, controlled and continuously improving global finance platform.

**Working Pattern**

India-based role with regular UK/EU hours overlap for global collaboration

**Purpose and Context**

FNZ has deployed Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations as a core global finance platform. Following global go-live, the Finance Systems team is strengthening permanent in-house capability to stabilise the platform, support Finance operations, deliver controlled improvements and prepare for future modules and entity deployments.

This is a hands-on functional role reporting to the Finance Systems Functional Lead - Finance & Operations. The role holder will configure and support D365, investigate issues, translate Finance requirements into workable solutions, produce documentation and test evidence, and contribute to controlled releases and continuous improvement.

The position requires practical D365 Finance experience. It is not a coordination-only or general business analyst role. The successful candidate must be comfortable working directly in the application, partnering with Finance users and technical teams, and taking assigned work through to a documented and supportable outcome.

**Key Responsibilities**

D365 Functional Support and Configuration

* Provide hands-on functional support across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash and Bank, Fixed Assets, Expense Management, Project Accounting and Financial Reporting.
* Configure approved changes in D365 under the direction and design authority of the D365 Functional Lead.
* Analyse business requirements, current processes and system behaviour; document solution options, functional requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain accurate configuration, process and support documentation so that knowledge is retained within FNZ.

Incident, Close and Operational Support

* Investigate functional incidents and service requests, reproduce issues, identify root causes and coordinate resolution with Finance users, technical teams and vendors.
* Support month-end and year-end close activities, reconciliations and business-critical finance processing, including agreed out-of-hours support where required.
* Distinguish defects, data issues, training needs and enhancement requests, ensuring each is progressed through the appropriate support or change process.
* Contribute to the upkeep of known-error records, support procedures, knowledge articles and recurring-issue analysis.

Change, Testing and Release Delivery

* Prepare functional specifications, process flows, test scenarios, test data and expected results for approved changes.
* Execute system, integration and regression testing; support business users with user acceptance testing and evidence capture.
* Assess the impact of proposed changes on modules, integrations, reporting, data, security and financial controls.
* Support release planning, deployment readiness, post-release validation and early-life support.

title: Assistant Manager Infrastructure & Network Management
company: Air India SATS Airport Services Private Limited (AISATS)
description:
**Job Title:**
**Assistant Manager – Infrastructure & Network Management**

**Department: Information Technology**

**Location: Gurgaon**

**Reporting to: Head of Technology**

**About the Role**

The role is responsible for managing enterprise IT infrastructure, network operations, systems administration, cloud and hosting environments, security controls, Microsoft platform administration and API integration ecosystems across multiple locations. The position will provide centralized governance while enabling effective support to distributed station-level IT teams, ensuring high availability, performance, security, scalability and operational continuity for business-critical technology services.

The ideal candidate will be a mid-to-senior level professional with 7 - 10+ years of relevant experience in complex, multi-location IT environments, preferably in aviation, logistics, ground handling, transportation, or other distributed operational industries.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Infrastructure & Server Management**

* Design, implement, administer and maintain enterprise IT infrastructure including on-premise servers, cloud infrastructure, virtualization platforms, storage, backup and related systems.
* Manage Windows and Linux server environments, including deployment, configuration, monitoring, patching, performance optimization, hardening and lifecycle management.
* Administer virtualization platforms such as VMware, Hyper-V, Nutanix, or equivalent technologies.
* Ensure server availability, capacity planning, backup readiness and operational resilience across business-critical systems.

**Network Management**

* Manage multi-OEM network infrastructure across centralized and station-level environments, including LAN, WAN, wireless, VPN, routing, switching, routers, switches, load balancers, DNS, DHCP and connectivity services.
* Monitor network health, availability, capacity and performance using enterprise monitoring and alerting tools.
* Troubleshoot complex network issues across multiple stations and coordinate timely resolution with internal teams, OEMs, service providers and vendors.
* Support network optimization initiatives to improve reliability, performance and user experience across locations.

**Cloud & Hosting**

* Administer Azure, AWS, or hybrid cloud environments, including cloud resources, hosting platforms, identity integrations, monitoring and governance controls.
* Support cloud infrastructure planning, migration, optimization, high availability, backup and disaster recovery requirements.
* Ensure cloud and hosted environments are aligned with organizational security, compliance, cost and performance expectations.

**Security & Firewall Management**

* Administer firewall configurations, rule changes, access policies, VPNs and network security controls in line with organizational governance standards.
* Perform infrastructure hardening, patch management, vulnerability remediation, audit support and compliance-related activities.
* Coordinate with information security teams to implement security controls, monitor risks and support incident response for infrastructure and network environments.

**API Integration & Management**

* Manage and support enterprise integration services including REST APIs, SOAP web services, API gateways, middleware, managed file transfer, messaging platforms and event-driven integrations.
* Oversee API lifecycle activities including integration design support, deployment coordination, monitoring, performance optimization, troubleshooting and governance.
* Support secure and reliable integration between enterprise applications, operational systems, cloud platforms and third-party systems.
* Coordinate with application, security, cloud and development teams to ensure API availability, security, scalability and compliance.

**Microsoft Ecosystem Administration**

* Administer Microsoft platforms including Azure Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Intune, endpoint management, identity and access management and related policy controls.
* Support user access governance, device compliance, endpoint security policies, licensing coordination and Microsoft platform operational support.
* Ensure Microsoft ecosystem administration is aligned with enterprise security, productivity and governance requirements.

**Multi-Location Operations Support**

* Provide centralized infrastructure and network governance for distributed operations across multiple stations or business locations.
* Support station-level IT teams in troubleshooting, escalations, technology rollouts, documentation and operational issue resolution.
* Ensure standardization of infrastructure processes, monitoring, change control, compliance, documentation and support practices across locations.

**Team, Vendor & Stakeholder Management**

* Coordinate with internal stakeholders, IT teams, OEMs, telecom service providers, cloud partners and technology vendors for operational support and project delivery.
* Manage vendor performance, service reviews, SLA adherence, escalation tracking and technology upgrade planning.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on availability, service quality, automation, risk reduction and operational efficiency.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, SOPs, inventory records, escalation matrices and operational runbooks.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Engineering, or a related discipline.

**Experience**

* 7 - 10+ years of relevant experience in IT infrastructure, network administration, systems management, cloud operations, security controls and enterprise integration support.
* Experience in multi-location organizations with distributed IT operations and business-critical infrastructure environments.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong administration experience in Windows Server and Linux environments.
* Hands-on knowledge of virtualization platforms such as VMware, Hyper-V, Nutanix, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of network technologies including LAN, WAN, routing, switching, VPN, firewalls, DNS, DHCP, load balancing and wireless infrastructure.
* Experience with multi-OEM network environments and vendor-supported technology landscapes.
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or hybrid cloud environments.
* Experience in firewall governance, network security controls, vulnerability remediation, patching and infrastructure hardening.
* Knowledge of API integrations, middleware, API gateways, REST/SOAP services, managed file transfers and messaging platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, IBM MQ, ActiveMQ, or Azure Service Bus.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, backup, disaster recovery and troubleshooting tools.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft administration including Azure AD, Microsoft 365, Intune, identity, access, endpoint and policy management.
* Exposure to scripting and automation using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar tools will be an advantage.

**Functional Skills**

* Strong understanding of incident management, change management, problem management and service request fulfilment.
* Ability to develop and maintain documentation, SOPs, governance processes, audit evidence and operational controls.
* Strong troubleshooting skills in distributed, high-availability and operationally sensitive environments.
* Ability to manage priorities, escalations, dependencies and vendor deliverables in a time-bound manner.

**Preferred Experience**

* Prior experience in aviation, airport operations, ground handling, logistics, transportation, manufacturing, or other multi-location operational environments.
* Experience supporting infrastructure for mission-critical applications and 24x7 business operations.
* Experience with hybrid cloud, disaster recovery planning, infrastructure modernization, automation and technology standardization initiatives.
* Certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect, CCNA, CCNP, VMware Certified Professional, ITIL Foundation, RHCSA, RHCE, or equivalent will be preferred.

**Key Competencies**

* Ownership mindset with strong accountability for infrastructure availability and operational continuity.
* Leadership capability to manage teams, vendors, escalations and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting and decision-making skills.
* Clear communication and documentation skills for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work in a dynamic, distributed and time-sensitive operational environment.
* Proactive approach to risk identification, service improvement, security and compliance.
* Collaborative mindset with the ability to partner with application, security, cloud, operations and business teams.

**Reporting Structure**

* The role will report to the Infrastructure Lead / Head of Technology.
* The role will work closely with application teams, Information security teams, station IT teams, business operations teams, service providers, OEMs and external technology partners.

**Location / Work Environment**

* The role will operate in a multi-location environment with centralized governance and distributed station-level support.
* The position may require coordination across corporate offices, operational stations, data centers, cloud environments, vendors and field IT teams.
* The candidate should be comfortable supporting business-critical operations, managing escalations and participating in planned maintenance, technology rollouts and incident response activities as required.

title: GMS-Senior-SSO-MFA
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**GDS – IAM MS SSO– Senior**
**Job Summary**
The SSO & Access Management Senior Consultant is responsible for providing operational support, administration, and continuous improvement of enterprise Single Sign-On (SSO) and Access Management platforms. This role supports global IAM operations through monitoring, troubleshooting, incident resolution, application onboarding, access governance, and platform optimization activities.
  
  
The consultant will work across industry-leading SSO technologies such as Okta, PingFederate, Ping One, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and related authentication and federation solutions, while ensuring adherence to security, compliance, and service management standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Administer and support enterprise SSO and Access Management platforms including Okta, PingFederate, Ping One, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and similar technologies.
* Provide L2/L3 operational support for authentication, authorization, federation, SSO, MFA, and access-related issues.
* Monitor platform health, availability, integrations, and security events to proactively identify and resolve issues.
* Manage incident, service request, problem, and change management activities in accordance with ITIL processes and SLAs.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective and preventive actions for recurring issues.
* Support user lifecycle management activities, including provisioning, de-provisioning, access modifications, and entitlement management.
* Lead and support onboarding of enterprise applications to SSO platforms.
* Configure and troubleshoot SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and WS-Federation integrations.
* Coordinate with application owners, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders during onboarding and enhancement activities.
* Manage certificates, metadata updates, federation configurations, and authentication policies.
* Support periodic access reviews, certification campaigns, and audit activities.
* Ensure compliance with organizational security standards, compliance requirements, and IAM best practices.
* Assist in implementation and maintenance of Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and access governance processes.
* Maintain operational and technical documentation, SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge articles.
* Drive continuous service improvement initiatives to enhance platform stability, user experience, and operational efficiency.
* Identify automation opportunities for repetitive operational tasks and reporting.
* Provide recommendations for improving authentication and access management processes.
* Collaborate closely with business application owners, security teams, infrastructure teams, and IAM stakeholders.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior analysts and team members.
* Participate in governance meetings, operational reviews, and client/service management discussions.
* Prepare operational reports, dashboards, KPI metrics, SLA performance reports, and management updates.

**Preferred Skills**

* 3-6 years of experience in identity and access management, with a strong focus on Okta/Ping Federate or similar IAM platforms.
* In-depth knowledge of IAM principles, SSO, MFA, directory services, and cloud identity management.
* Proven track record of managing complex user provisioning and de-provisioning scenarios.
* Familiarity with IT security standards and compliance frameworks (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, GDPR).
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
* Strong leadership abilities and experience mentoring junior staff.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact with various stakeholders.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., Okta Certified Administrator, Okta Certified Consultant, Okta Certified Professional) are highly desirable

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field.

**Work Requirements**

* Willingness to work in rotational shifts supporting global operations.
* Willingness to participate in on-call support rotations.
* Ability to support critical production incidents outside standard business hours when required.
* Willingness to travel occasionally based on business requirements.
* Ability to work effectively within a Managed Services delivery model.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Officer Digital Farming
description:

At Netafim, we work side by side with millions of farmers and communities around the world to address one of agriculture’s most pressing challenges: how to produce more food with fewer resources in an increasingly unpredictable environment. Together, we help improve decision-making in the field and drive better outcomes across crops and climates — turning complexity into clarity and making agriculture more precise, efficient, and sustainable to enable farmers to grow more with less.

Orbia Advance Corporation is a company driven by a shared purpose: to advance life around the world. Orbia operates in the Polymer Solutions, Building & Infrastructure (Wavin), Precision Agriculture (Netafim), Connectivity Solutions (Dura-Line) and Fluor & Energy Materials sectors. The five Orbia business groups have a collective focus on ensuring food and water security, expanding information access and connectivity, and advancing decarbonization and the energy transition with basic and advanced materials, specialty products, and innovative solutions. Orbia has a global team of over 22,000 employees, commercial activities in more than 100 countries and operations in over 50, with a strong U.S. manufacturing presence and headquarters in Boston, Mexico City, Amsterdam, and Tel Aviv. The company generated $7.6 billion in revenue in 2025. To learn more, visit: orbia.com

Install, operate, and maintain Digital Farming Systems at customer sites.
  
  
Troubleshoot electrical and system issues and provide on-ground technical support.
  
  
Ensure efficient irrigation and fertigation operations aligned with crop requirements.
  
  
Guide farmers on irrigation/fertigation schedules and best practices.
  
  
Train customers, dealers, and internal staff on usage, benefits, and maintenance of DFS solutions.
  
  
Generate and maintain AMC agreements with existing customers.

Diploma, ITI, or technical degree in Electrical, Electronics, Agriculture Engineering, or related field.
  
  
Basic electrical systems, wiring, and field installation knowledge.
  
  
Willingness to work in field assignments and customer sites.
  
  
Must own a two-wheeler with valid driving license.

title: Specialist/Engineer Service Operations
description:
**Overview**
**WELCOME TO**
**SITA**
At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.
  
  
You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a
**Great Place to Work**
® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.
  
  
Are you ready to love your job?
  
  
The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
  
  
**About The Role & Team**
You will be the first point of contact for customers, delivering timely, accurate, and customer-focused IT support. You will own incidents and service requests through to resolution or approved handover, ensuring clear communication and high-quality service at every stage. Working within SITA's global service model, you will leverage ServiceNow, standardized processes, and defined escalation paths to provide a consistent support experience across regions and channels while contributing to operational excellence and customer satisfaction.
  
  
The Service Desk provides 24/7 global support from Delhi and Montreal, managing incidents, service requests, customer communications and escalations through to resolution.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Incident End-to-End Ownership**

* Own assigned incidents and requests from logging through resolution, closure or accepted handover.
* Complete diagnosis,use approved knowledge and engage resolver groups with clear evidence while retaining customer-facing ownership.
* Recognize potential P1 or Major Incident conditions,invoke the defined escalation path and support coordination, timeline capture and communications.
* Maintain disciplined shift handovers so priority work and customer commitments remain owned during reduced coverage.

**Customer Outcomes**

* Prioritize restoration and reduction of customer impact, not ticket completion alone.
* Communicate progress, ownership, next steps and follow-up in clear language.
* Confirm the agreed outcome before closure and record unresolved concerns.

**AI, Automation and Tooling Adoption**

* Use approved AI-assisted triage, summarization, knowledge recommendation and routing with required human validation.
* Use automated workflows and self-service handoffs correctly and intervene when automation does not protect the customer outcome.
* Identify repetitive demand, failed automation and missing knowledge with supporting evidence.

**Data, Service Intelligence and Predictive Awareness**

* Use queues, dashboards, service status and known-error information to prioritize work.
* Recognize patterns indicating repeat failure, rising demand or degradation and escalate with evidence.
* Record accurate categorization, timestamps, impact, diagnosis and resolution information.

**ServiceNow Greenfield and CMDB Maturity**

* Follow approved ServiceNow workflows, states, assignment paths and closure controls.
* Use available service and configuration data in diagnosis and routing.
* Report suspected CMDB inaccuracies and maintain records that support reporting, automation and auditability.

**Workforce Transformation and Continuous Improvement**

* Adopt global queues, new channels, revised processes and changing skills requirements.
* Complete required learning and share knowledge across shifts.
* Contribute practical improvement feedback based on operational evidence.

**Qualifications**
**ABOUT YOUR SKILLS**

* 3+ years of experience in Service Desk, technical support, customer support or operations.
* Practical incident handling, troubleshooting, communication and escalation experience.
* Ability to use ITSM workflows, knowledge and dashboards.
* Relevant technical, service management, operations or equivalent professional experience.
* ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent demonstrated ITSM knowledge.

**NICE-TO-HAVE**

* Experience with ServiceNow, AI-assisted support, automation, self-service or virtual agents.
* Exposure to CMDB or service configuration data.

**What We Offer**
We’re all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We’re really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.
  
  
🏡
**Flex Week:**
Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team’s needs)
  
  
⏰
**Flex Day:**
Make your workday suit your life and plans.
  
  
🌎
**Flex Location:**
Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.
  
  
🌿
**Employee Wellbeing:**
We’ve got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health – a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.
  
  
🚀
**Professional Development**
: At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From
**LinkedIn Learning**
,
**Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative**
, and
**Airport Council International**
—available to all employees—to specialized solutions like
**Pluralsight**
for technology upskilling,
**Harvard Business Publishing**
for people leadership,
**Stanford**
for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way.
  
  
**🙌🏽 Competitive Benefits**
: Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.
  
  
*SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self-identify in the application process.*
**Salary / Compensation Note**
Hidden (-999)

title: Software Portfolio Specialist - Delhi NCR (Hybrid)
description:
Are you looking to join an organization that is growing and dynamic? What about a high-energy, collaborative environment that rewards hard work?

J.S. Held is a global consulting firm that combines technical, scientific, financial, and strategic expertise to advise clients seeking to realize value and mitigate risk. Our Professionals serve as trusted advisors to organizations facing high stakes matters demanding urgent attention, staunch integrity, proven experience, clear-cut analysis, and an understanding of both tangible and intangible assets.

The firm provides a comprehensive suite of services, products, and data that enables clients to navigate complex, contentious, and often catastrophic situations.

**Job Description**

The Software Portfolio Specialist supports the end-to-end management of the organization’s software application portfolio, from initial business need and sourcing through provisioning, ongoing administration, renewal, optimization, and retirement. This role partners with business stakeholders, Purchasing, Cybersecurity, software vendors, and other IT teams to ensure applications are effectively managed and aligned with business needs.

As a founding member of our new Delhi hub, this individual will play a key role in helping establish and shape the function locally, contributing to process development, operational excellence, and the long-term growth of the team while supporting a global technology environment.

**Job Responsibilities**

**Software Application Management**

* Support the full lifecycle of software applications, including evaluation, onboarding, administration, optimization, renewal, and retirement.
* Administer software applications as assigned, including user access, license allocation, account provisioning/deprovisioning, and routine configuration.
* Coordinate with other Technology teams on application-related security, identity/access, endpoint, infrastructure, architecture, and support requirements.
* Maintain accurate application records, including licensing information, business ownership, renewal dates, contracts, entitlements, and other portfolio data.
* Execute established policies, procedures, and controls.
* Support software license optimization and reclamation activities.
* Assist with license and user audits to promote compliance with contractual requirements.
* Gather and analyze business requirements for new applications.
* Assess existing applications to determine whether current solutions can meet a business need before introducing additional software.
* Support application integration activities associated with mergers and acquisitions.
* Coordinate software demonstrations, solution discussions, and technical/vendor evaluations.
* Support cross-functional evaluation of new software, including applicable Cybersecurity, Compliance, Legal, Purchasing, and technical reviews.
* Use AI, workflow automation, and intelligent agents to modernize software asset management.
* Help develop an increasingly autonomous operating model, where routine activities are proactively identified and automated.
* Maintain application documentation, SOPs, knowledge articles, and administration guides.

**Procurement and Sourcing**

* Support software sourcing, procurement, contract renewal, and licensing activities.
* Engage software vendors and resellers to obtain pricing, proposals, licensing options, and product information.
* Assist with vendor negotiations and evaluate commercial options to support competitive pricing and appropriate licensing.
* Proactively analyze licensing, usage, and market options to develop innovative recommendations for cost optimization and portfolio consolidation.
* Track software agreements, renewal dates, license quantities, costs, and contractual requirements.
* Review software usage and licensing needs ahead of renewals to identify opportunities for consolidation, right-sizing, or cost avoidance.
* Develop and maintain productive relationships with software vendors and internal sourcing partners.

**Incident and Request Management**

* Manage assigned software application incidents, service requests, and tasks
* Review and triage requests, gather missing information, troubleshoot application issues, and coordinate resolution.
* Serve as a liaison between end users, internal technology teams, and vendor support
* Monitor assigned queues and follow up on outstanding approvals, dependencies, and actions.
* Escalate application issues appropriately based on business impact, complexity, or required technical expertise.
* Identify recurring support issues and contribute to knowledge articles, process improvements, and self-service documentation.
* Ability to develop innovative, practical solutions and confidently challenge established practices when improvement opportunities exist.
* Support software access requests and new application requests in accordance with established governance processes.

**Qualifications**

* Self-starter who demonstrates initiative, ownership, curiosity, and a proactive approach to identifying and solving problems.
* Ability to develop innovative, practical solutions and confidently challenge established practices when improvement opportunities exist.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with attention to detail and the ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities.
* Ability to learn new technologies and platforms quickly
* Experience in software application management, application support, IT operations, and cross-functional enterprise IT environments.
* Understanding of application lifecycle management and software asset management best practices.
* Working knowledge of different types of software and licenses
* Hands on experience with ServiceNow Software Asset Management Professional (SAM Pro) and IT Service Management (ITSM), including incident and request management.
* Experience working with software vendors, procurement processes, contracts, licensing, renewals, license optimization, and reclamation.
* Understanding of single sign-on (SSO), software installation and configuration requirements preferred.
* Experience supporting application implementations or technology projects preferred.

title: Data Center Technician, Global Server Operations
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Experience with performing component-level repairs and troubleshooting on technical equipment.
* Experience diagnosing and troubleshooting one of the following: operating systems, computer/server hardware, or networking protocols.
* Ability to lift/move 50lb (23kg) of equipment and ability to exert yourself physically over extended periods of time, including frequent bending, kneeling, climbing, pushing/pulling and lifting.
* Ability to work non-standard hours, including working weekends, night shifts, holidays and on shift-based schedules as required.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* Completion of the online Google IT Support Professional Certificate program.
* 2 years of experience diagnosing and troubleshooting one of the following: operating systems and computer/server hardware or networking protocols.
* Experience working within a data center or network operation center environment.

**About The Job**
Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.
  
  
As a Data Center Technician, you'll deploy and maintain Google's advanced Data Center Server and Network Infrastructure by installing, configuring, testing, troubleshooting, and repairing hardware and server software. You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, bridges, and switches. You will participate in or lead local project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans.
  
  
In this role, your duties range from the physical deployment of data center related technology to working closely with various stakeholders. It will fall on you to ensure that our goals, missions and projects are successfully delivered, and, more importantly, that they are repeatable across our global array of data centers.
  
  
The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical and HVAC systems in the world. We are an upbeat, creative, team-oriented group of engineers committed to building and operating powerful data centers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Deploy and operate new data center infrastructure across projects or teams (e.g., machine learning platforms, network architecture).
* Report issues and follow data center procedures to troubleshoot and diagnose moderately complex issues with equipment or infrastructure as they arise, and identify the resources needed to resolve identified issues.
* Diagnose, repair, and perform preventative maintenance on equipment, servers, machines, and infrastructure based on identified issues with multiple solutions, independently.
* Execute advanced operational procedures as part of daily work activities and follow security policies and processes.
* Collaborate with the partner teams (e.g., Program Managers, Data Center Operations, Software and Hardware Engineers) to complete tasks, escalate and resolve defined problems.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Financial Systems Analyst II
description:
**Job Description**
As part of the Financial Reporting Quality Assurance (FRQA) organization within Corporate Controllership, this role is accountable for overseeing critical Level 1 production support processes for financial systems, including data sourcing, ingestion, transformation, validation, operational calendar management, end-to-end process coordination, and incident management.
  
  
The team maintains deep knowledge of data sources, processing workflows, and regulatory reporting requirements, and is responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving incidents across a broad range of finance technology platforms. Success in this role requires strong technical expertise, financial acumen, disciplined operational execution, proactive monitoring, and timely incident resolution.
  
  
The Service Management Financial System Analyst is expected to be collaborative, highly organized, and results oriented, with responsibility for end-to-end operational monitoring, incident tracking, triage, problem management, and support of financial system reliability, stability, and performance.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
This role is responsible for ensuring financial systems operations are effectively governed, executed, monitored, controlled, and continuously improved. Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Manage operational processes to ensure financial systems function as intended, processes run efficiently, and required controls and auditability are maintained.
* Ensure successful completion of daily operational activities in alignment with established processing calendars, controls, and service expectations.
* Collaborate with business, finance, and technology stakeholders to triage incidents, manage resolution activities, and support timely root cause analysis.
* Identify recurring incident themes and partner with technology and business teams to drive sustainable remediation and reduce operational risk.
* Drive continuous improvement through process optimization, standardization, and automation.
* Assess the operational impact of production changes and ensure runbooks, procedures, and related documentation are updated accurately and on time.
* Develop, operationalize, and monitor dashboards that provide transparency into process health, operational performance, and service management trends.
* Document business and technical requirements for enhancements, standard operating procedures, and process improvements.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, audit, and control management requirements.
* Identify, document, implement, and periodically test operational controls in accordance with RCSA/PRSA guidelines to confirm control effectiveness.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a technology-related field, preferably Computer Science.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience in financial systems implementation, production support, and incident management for financial systems.
* Advanced knowledge of relational database and data management concepts, with strong proficiency in SQL and exposure to both traditional and modern data technologies.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex financial, business, and technology concepts for diverse stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously and consistently meet critical deadlines.
* Ability to perform effectively in a high-pressure environment and make sound decisions in challenging situations.
* Proven transformational mindset, with a focus on improving process efficiency and operational effectiveness.
* Self-starter and proactive team player with a strong commitment to delivering high-quality service and meeting stakeholder expectations.
* Experience with accounting and reporting processes, including financial and regulatory reporting, is preferred.
* Flexibility is essential for this production support role, including the ability to work in shifts and provide weekend support on a rotational basis.

Technical Skills & Knowledge of Platforms
  
  

* Advanced SQL skills for data analysis and production incident troubleshooting, including the ability to write complex queries and perform multi-table joins.
* Proficiency with MS Excel, PowerPoint, MemSQL, and Putty for incident triage, reporting, and operational support.
* Advanced knowledge of job scheduling tools such as Airflow and Automic is required.
* Experience in Generative AI frameworks would be an added advantage.
* Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including BigQuery, Cloud Storage, monitoring, logging, IAM, production support, maintenance, and troubleshooting, is preferred.
* Experience with AxiomSL is preferred.
* Knowledge of Flink and Beam server is preferred.
* Experience with ServiceNow and Jira is preferred.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

title: AVIT Meeting Room Operations L3 Lead
description:

**Job Description**
**AVIT Meeting Room**
**Operations L3 Lead**
**Role Overview**
The role leads a technically skilled Level 3 operations team supporting meeting-room devices and connected peripherals. It combines hands-on technical leadership with service management, work allocation, escalation ownership, operational governance, reporting, and continuous improvement. The Lead works closely with monitoring teams, engineering, project teams, onsite support, service desk, platform teams, vendors and technology stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Operational Leadership**

* Lead daily L3 operations, balancing incidents, service requests, onboarding and offboarding activities, problem investigations, and improvement work.
* Allocate work based on priority, impact, technical complexity, regional coverage and resource availability.
* Run operational reviews and shift handovers, ensuring ownership, blockers, risks and next actions are clearly documented.
* Maintain effective support coverage and act as the primary operational escalation point for the L3 team.
* Coach team members, strengthen technical capability, and encourage consistent troubleshooting and documentation practices.

**Advanced Incident and Problem Management**

* Provide technical direction for complex meeting-room incidents that cannot be resolved by L1, L2 or monitoring teams.
* Coordinate diagnosis across endpoint, operating system, application, account, network, peripheral and room-integration dependencies.
* Own major or recurring issue progression, bringing together internal resolver groups, engineering teams and vendors as required.
* Ensure incident records include clear technical findings, actions, evidence, workarounds, resolution details and follow-up requirements.
* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for repeat failures, alert noise and avoidable ticket demand.

**Service Reliability and Monitoring**

* Use operational data and monitoring insights to identify device-health risks, recurring alert patterns, estate-wide issues and service degradation.
* Partner with monitoring and engineering teams to improve alert quality, routing, thresholds and actionable diagnostics.
* Track device compliance, connectivity, application and operating-system health, and operational readiness across in-scope platforms.
* Coordinate recovery campaigns and validate that restored devices remain stable after corrective action.

**Device Lifecycle Operations**

* Oversee operational support for meeting-room device onboarding, configuration validation, readiness testing, BAU handover, replacement and offboarding.
* Confirm that prerequisite activities, dependencies, ownership and acceptance criteria are understood before L3 work begins.
* Coordinate with project managers, onsite support and dependent platform teams to resolve gaps affecting deployment or decommissioning.
* Maintain accurate operational records, handover evidence and supporting documentation for lifecycle activities.

**Stakeholder, Vendor and Escalation Management**

* Provide concise updates on service impact, current status, risks, decisions, dependencies and expected next actions.
* Facilitate technical bridges and cross-team troubleshooting for high-impact or multi-domain issues.
* Engage OEMs and support partners for advanced diagnostics, defect investigation, warranty and replacement cases.
* Ensure escalations are evidence-based, assigned to the appropriate owner and progressed until closure or formal handoff.

**Governance, Reporting and Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain and improve standard operating procedures, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, support boundaries and escalation paths.
* Review service performance, ticket ageing, recurring failure themes, backlog, restoration trends and improvement opportunities.
* Drive automation, monitoring enhancements, self-heal opportunities and ticket-elimination initiatives with measurable outcomes.
* Support operational readiness for new products, platform changes, service transitions and global deployment programmes.
* Promote compliance with change, incident, problem, asset, security and data-handling requirements.

**Technology and Service Environment**
**Area Indicative Environment**
**Meeting-room platforms :**
Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows and Android, Surface Hub, interactive displays, video-conferencing endpoints, room bars, cameras, microphones, speakers, touch panels and room-signage devices
  
  
**Operations tooling :**
ServiceNow, Microsoft Pro Management Portal, monitoring platforms such as Utelogy, Microsoft Intune, reporting dashboards and knowledge repositories
  
  
**Technical domains :**
Windows and Android endpoints, Teams Rooms applications, device accounts, identity and access, networking fundamentals, firmware, drivers, peripherals, remote management and AV signal flow
  
  
**Service practices**
: Incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, asset, vendor, warranty/RMA, onboarding, offboarding and operational reporting
  
  
**Candidate Profile**
**Required Experience And Knowledge**

* Demonstrable experience leading or coordinating advanced AV, unified communications, meeting-room or endpoint operations in an enterprise environment.
* Strong troubleshooting experience across Microsoft Teams Rooms, room peripherals, endpoint operating systems, device management and network dependencies.
* Experience managing complex incidents, technical escalations, vendors and cross-functional resolver teams.
* Practical understanding of IT service management processes, including incident, problem, change, request and knowledge management.
* Experience producing operational reports, trend analysis, executive updates, technical documentation and knowledge content.
* Ability to work effectively in a global support model and coordinate across regions, time zones and diverse stakeholder groups.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in information technology, electronics, telecommunications, AV systems or a related discipline.
* Relevant Microsoft, ITIL, vendor or service-management certification.
* Experience with ServiceNow, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Pro Management Portal, Power BI, Power Query or comparable monitoring and analytics platforms.
* Exposure to device lifecycle programmes, service transition, automation and large-scale operational recovery initiatives.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Full-time

ETAP is seeking a skilled Services Support Engineer to support SCADA, DMS/ADMS, RTU, industrial automation, and power system automation activities. The role involves system engineering, configuration, maintenance, troubleshooting, integration, testing, commissioning, and customer support.
  
  
The selected candidate will initially be deployed at Bokaro Steel Limited (BSL) for SCADA and RTU Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) activities. Based on business requirements, the engineer may subsequently support other AMC sites and SCADA/automation projects across India or other locations.

* Diagnose communication failures, missing or stale data, alarms, events, and DI/DO/command/AI signal issues.
* Work with IEC 60870-5-104, Modbus TCP/IP, and other relevant substation communication protocols.
* Maintain industrial Ethernet networks, managed Layer 2/Layer 3 switches, routers, VLANs, and related OT connectivity.
* Perform SCADA database configuration, tag mapping, HMI/SLD updates, system integration, and feeder/substation integration.
* Support installation, testing, commissioning, FAT/SAT, and troubleshooting of SCADA/DMS/ADMS and automation systems.
* Maintain configuration backups, conduct preventive maintenance, and implement approved software and configuration changes.
* Prepare maintenance reports, technical documentation, test procedures, configuration logs, and root cause analysis (RCA) reports.
* Coordinate with customers, internal engineering teams, site managers, and OEMs to resolve technical issues.

**Essential Skills And Qualifications**

* Diploma or bachelor’s degree in electrical, Electronics and Communication, Instrumentation, Automation, Computer Science, or Information Technology Engineering.
* Relevant experience in SCADA, RTU/PLC, industrial automation, or power system automation.
* Working knowledge of RTU/PLC systems, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3, IEC 61850, Modbus TCP/IP, TCP/IP networking, and managed Ethernet switches.
* Understanding of SCADA databases, signal configuration, Windows Server, and system backup procedures.
* Basic understanding of electrical substations, power systems, protection relays, and field communication.
* Good troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, and customer communication skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with SCADA/DMS/ADMS projects, commissioning, and substation automation.
* Knowledge of IEC 60870-5-101, IEC 61850, OPC, SQL/MongoDB, and historian systems.
* Familiarity with Python, C#, PowerShell, Wireshark, VLANs, and industrial network security.
* Knowledge of NMS, SAN/storage, fibre-optic communication, and GPS/NTP time synchronization.
* CCNA or other relevant technical certifications will be an advantage.

**Other Requirements**

* Willingness to work initially at BSL, Bokaro, and travel to other customer sites as required.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while following site lead instructions.
* Flexibility to support commissioning, planned maintenance, and critical breakdowns outside normal working hours when required.

Career Opportunity
  
  
The role offers exposure to SCADA maintenance, power automation, system integration, engineering, testing, and commissioning, enabling long-term technical growth within ETAP.
  
  
**ETAP requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.**
**ETAP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business.**
**Come and join ETAP to create the transformative technology that enables our customers to engineer a better world.**

title: Senior Network Infrastructure Engineer
description:

* Strong background of Mellanox/Cumulus OS.
* Working knowledge of Infiniband technology.

* Passionate about innovating and investing in ground breaking technologies.

title: Zoho CRM & Integration Specialist
description:

Position: Zoho CRM & Integration Specialist

Experience: Relevant hands-on experience in CRM implementation and integrations

Location: Janakpuri, New Delhi

Salary: 6 LPA - 9.5 LPA

Role Overview

We are looking for a technically proficient CRM professional who can independently implement, integrate, automate, and troubleshoot business systems. The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience connecting CRM platforms with lead-generation sources, WhatsApp, dialers, telephony systems, and other business applications.

This is not a basic CRM data-entry, CRM administration, or campaign-execution role. We need someone who understands integrations at a technical level and can diagnose and resolve real-world issues.

1. CRM Implementation & Integration — Mandatory

* Implementation of duplicate lead prevention across multiple lead sources.
* Building customer-matching logic using mobile numbers, email addresses, or unique customer IDs.

2. Dialer & Telephony Integration — Mandatory

* Hands-on experience integrating CRM with dialers or telephony platforms.

* Configuration of auto-dialer campaigns.

title: Assistant Manager - Customer Experience
description:
**Customer Experience Team**
The Customer Experience team plays a critical role in ensuring the successful adoption and ongoing performance of GreyOrange’s warehouse automation solutions. Acting as the primary bridge between customers and internal teams, the CEM function drives solution optimization, handles operational escalations, ensures SLA adherence, and delivers a seamless post-go-live experience. The team focuses on maximizing customer satisfaction, system uptime, and business value through proactive support, data-driven insights, and continuous engagement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Customer Engagement & Communication**

* Manage day-to-day customer interactions, ensuring clear and consistent communication across all touchpoints
* Handle escalations promptly and professionally, ensuring quick issue resolution and customer satisfaction
* Conduct periodic business reviews (MBR, QBR, EBR) and ensure stakeholder alignment
* Lead daily and weekly performance reviews with high-level stakeholders. Assist and ensure success of monthly and quarterly business reviews.
* Act as the lead coordinator to address customers prioritized hot topics
* Own crisis coordination for any severity-1 incident within your personal account portfolio, escalating only for true exceptions

**Solution Performance & Optimization**

* Understand solution configurations and optimize them for operational and technical performance
* Support planning for peak periods, including volume forecasting, resource planning, and system readiness
* Track and report system performance metrics (hardware/software uptime, throughput, order accuracy)
* Own performance governance for a personal portfolio of 4-6 complex, high-stakes accounts (multi-site, high 24/7-criticality, or highly technical configurations), often including a peak-critical account
* Coordinate peak readiness and cross-functional escalations across more than one account, supporting peer Customer Experience Managers when needed

**Data & Reporting**

* Use basic SQL and tools like Grafana and Power BI to analyze performance data and generate insights
* Monitor dashboards for real-time system visibility and performance tracking
* Own operational reporting and performance metric updates for internal and external stakeholders
* Maintain a Customer Happiness Index (CHI) score above 7 across your personal account book, or maintain a credible, documented improvement plan where it is not

**Customer Success & Process Improvement**

* Drive customer success metrics such as CSAT, NPS, and AMC renewals
* Identify and implement initiatives to improve customer onboarding, adoption, and satisfaction
* Document lessons learned, best practices, and enablement content for continuous improvement
* Contribute at least one improvement per year to a shared template or playbook (e.g., Joint Success Plan, Path to Green, onboarding playbook) used by the wider Customer Experience team

**Collaboration & Upgrades**

* Work closely with Product, Solution Architecture, Support, and Program Management to deliver software enhancements and new features
* Plan and coordinate system upgrades, patch deployments, and feature rollouts
* Align with customers on change requests, scope, and delivery timelines.
* Engage CloudOps, SRE, and QA teams credibly on complex technical detail for high-stakes, multi-site accounts

**Team Leadership & Mentorship**

* Serve as an informal quality reviewer and sounding board for peers’ Joint Success Plans (JSPs), Root Cause Analyses (RCAs), and health-check decks — leading through expertise, not formal authority
* Provide coaching and informal mentorship to junior Customer Experience Managers (CEM I/II) across the team

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Adherence to Software & Hardware uptime greater than 98%
* Ensuring higher MTBF and lower MTTR
* Operational KPIs such as order fulfilment speed & accuracy greater than 99% and Inventory Management
* SLA-based issue resolution and escalation turnaround
* Customer satisfaction and NPS scores
* AMC renewal rate and service utilization
* Accuracy and timeliness of reporting and dashboard updates
* Customer Happiness Index (CHI) score greater than 7 across personal account portfolio
* At least one shared template or playbook improvement contributed per year
* Successful coordination of peak readiness across personal portfolio and at least one peer account

**Required Qualifications**

* A proven track record managing enterprise-level clients with high-stakes, 24/7 operational requirements, or deep warehouse-operations management experience
* 5-7 years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Facing roles, Consulting, Technical Project Management, Solutions Design, Warehouse Operations or Account Management within the SaaS, Robotics, or Industrial Automation sectors
* Proficiency in data visualization tools to turn raw logs into executive-level performance stories
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure), database management, and API-driven integrations.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* Familiarity with SQL and analytics platforms (e.g., Grafana, Power BI)
* Understanding of customer success metrics: CSAT, NPS, renewals
* Experience in warehouse automation, robotics, or supply chain preferred
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment
* Strong project management skills to manage multiple cross functional initiatives in parallel
* Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, or informally lead junior colleagues; experience managing 2-3 direct reports is a plus.
* A valid US visa with the ability to travel for US customer engagements is preferred and highly advantageous.

title: Microsoft Dynamics365 Business Central Functional Consultant
description:
**Company Description**
Hithlaksh Solutions Private Limited specializes in delivering innovative products, services, and technology solutions that help businesses excel in their industries. The company focuses on understanding client needs and translating them into efficient, scalable business solutions. By combining domain expertise with modern platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics365 Business Central, Hithlaksh supports organizations in improving operations and decision-making. Team members collaborate in a dynamic environment that values problem-solving, client success, and continuous improvement.

**Role Description**
This is a part-time, remote role for a Microsoft Dynamics365 Business Central Functional Consultant with 10+ years of experience in Business Central. The consultant will work closely with clients to analyze business processes, gather requirements, and translate them into Business Central configurations and workflows. Daily responsibilities include conducting functional workshops, preparing documentation, supporting solution design and testing, and providing user training and post-implementation support. The role also involves collaborating with technical teams to ensure successful integrations, troubleshooting functional issues, and recommending improvements that align with client business and finance objectives. The consultant is expected to manage their tasks independently while maintaining clear communication with clients and internal stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* Strong analytical skills to assess business requirements, interpret data, and design effective Business Central solutions.
* Excellent communication skills to conduct workshops, gather requirements, document processes, and collaborate with clients and internal teams.
* Solid understanding of business processes across operations, supply chain, and related functional areas within an ERP context.
* Consulting experience in implementing or supporting Microsoft Dynamics365 Business Central or similar ERP platforms, including client-facing engagements.
* Knowledge of finance processes such as general ledger, accounts payable/receivable, budgeting, and financial reporting within ERP systems.
* Experience with configuration, testing, and user training in Microsoft Dynamics365 Business Central is highly beneficial.
* Ability to work independently in a remote setting, prioritize tasks, and meet project timelines.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field; relevant certifications in Microsoft Dynamics365 or Business Central are an advantage.

title: Technical Services Engineer
description:
Job Description:

1. Pre-Sales Technical Support: Collaborate with the sales team to conduct preliminary technical communication and needs assessment with local pharmaceutical companies in India. Gain in-depth insight into customers' after-sales maintenance service needs throughout the equipment lifecycle, specifically covering: equipment installation and commissioning, regular maintenance and repairs, system upgrades and retrofits, utility system support, and spare parts supply.
2. Project Delivery & Execution: Participate in or lead preventive maintenance, fault diagnosis, and repair of pharmaceutical equipment, ensuring services comply with GMP regulations and customer standards. Participate in or lead upgrade, retrofit, and maintenance service projects for pharmaceutical water systems, powder processing systems, automation control systems, utility systems, and related equipment.
3. Customer Relationship & Ongoing Service: Establish and maintain strong customer relationships. Act as the primary technical point of contact, continuously following up on evolving customer needs.

Job Requirements:

1. Language Proficiency: Must be fluent in English, capable of using them as working languages for technical communication, proposal writing, and customer interaction. Knowledge of Chinese is a significant plus.
2. Industry Experience: Minimum 3 years of work experience in the pharmaceutical industry or with a renowned pharmaceutical engineering company, with a solid understanding of pharmaceutical plant production operations, equipment management, HAVC or engineering services. Proficiency in at least one of the following areas is required: pharmaceutical water systems, powder process systems, automation control systems , or critical process equipment.
3. Travel & Adaptability: Able to adapt to frequent short- and medium-term business travel within India. Possess strong on-site adaptability at customer locations and the ability to work independently.

title: Senior Business Systems Analyst
description:
**About ETS**
ETS is a global education and talent solutions organization enabling lifelong learners worldwide to be future-ready. For more than 75 years, we've been advancing the science of measurement to build benchmarks for fair and valid skill assessment across cultures and borders. Our worldwide impact extends through our renowned assessments including TOEFL®, TOEIC®, GRE® and Praxis® tests, serving millions of learners in more than 200 countries and territories. Through strategic acquisitions, we've expanded our global capabilities: PSI strengthens our workforce assessment solutions, while Edusoft, Kira Talent, Pipplet, Vericant, and Wheebox enhance our educational technology and assessment platforms across critical markets worldwide.
  
  
Through ETS Research Institute and ETS Solutions, we're partnering with educational institutions, governments, and organizations globally to promote skill proficiency, empower upward mobility, and unlock opportunities for everyone, everywhere. With offices and partners across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas, we deliver nearly 50 million tests annually. Join us in our journey of measuring progress to power human progress worldwide.
  
  
The Senior Business Systems Analyst (BSA) functions as a liason between business units thoughout ETS and the IT departments, participates in business process modeling and research efforts and completes business cases in support of IT projects. The incumbent works with the Strategic Business Unit (SBU) proposal team to develop the scope of work necessary to support the requirements of the proposal, identifies delivery solutions and works to develop cost reviews and prepare a technical response to the client that proposes solutions to meet business needs. This role participates in the formulation and definition of project scope and objectives for assigned departmental projects. Additionally, the BSA, Senior participates in requirements gathering and documentation and prepares detailed systems specifications from which programs are written or configured. The Senior Business Systems Analyst communicates with the IT team to ensure proper development, operationalization and delivery of technical solutions that fully adhere to corporate business objectives and meet user specifications for functionality and accuracy.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Facilitate communication between IT, SBUs and clients
* Participate in software development groups and teams in requirements gathering, analysis, design, risk mitigation,programming/construction, unit testing and transition of applications into a production environment.
* Gather and document business requirements and functional/detail requirements
* Translate business requirements to functional and technical specifications
* Function as a liason between business areas and technical staff
* Develop scope of work to satisfy business goals and requirements
* Provide detailed review and documentation of costs for proposed solutions
* Work with system developers, test teams, process managers, and end users to ensure proposed solution is delivered according to schedule and with the required functionality
* Analyze/document new and existing processes and procedures
* Continuously review test plans and provide feedback on methodology when necessary
* Participate in conducting regularly scheduled reviews of newly proposed and exiting projects to ensure quality and accuracy is delivered to end users
* Maintain traceability matrix and manage change requests
* Function as contact for problem analysis and resolution
* Work as part of a team to conceptualize solutions for the improvement of business goals
* Apply industry standard analysis, documentation techniques where appropriate to assist in providing optimum solutions
* Follow SDLC (Software Development Lifecycle) processes
* Adhere to ethical standards and comply with the laws and regulations applicable to your job function.
* Prior experience with software testing standards, practices, methods and tools
* Excellent planning, organization and problem identification skills
* Excellent information and data analysis skills
* Prior experience in financial applications preferred
* Demonstrated problem solving ability
* Excellent technical and business terminology to consult with clients, vendors and other internal staff
* Proven ability to work effectively on multiple projects simultaneously (balance workload)
* Ability to work in a collaborative, team-based environment

**Education, Certifications, Or Special Licenses**

* A Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Information Processing, or business-related curricula, or an equivalent combination of education and experience from which comparable knowledge and abilities can be acquired, is necessary.
* 4+ years of experience in defining/developing software products and/or managing software development efforts.

**ETS is mission driven and action oriented**

* We are passionate about hiring innovative thinkers who believe in the promise of education and lifelong learning.
* We are energized by cultivating growth, innovation, and continuous transformation for the next generation of rising professionals as leaders. Â In support of this ETS offers multiple Business Resource Groups (BRG) for you to learn and advance your career growth!
* As a not-for-profit organization we will encourage you to lean in to your passion for volunteering. Â At ETS you may qualify for up to an additional 8 hours of PTO for volunteer work on causes that are important to you!
* The base salary range advertised represents the low and high end of the anticipated salary range for this position. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate's geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. The base pay is only one aspect of the Total Rewards Package that will be offered to the successful candidate.

**ETS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe in creating a work environment where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity.**
