title: Field Service Specialist
description:
**Overview**
At QIAGEN, we are driven by a simple but powerful vision: making improvements in life possible.
  
  
We’re dedicated to revolutionizing science and healthcare for the better. From our entrepreneurial roots to our current global presence, we've grown into a force for positive change. With thousands of employees across six continents, collaboration is our greatest strength. We’re always striving to identify talented individuals to join our exceptional teams.
  
  
We have played a pivotal role in shaping modern science and healthcare, and we're just getting started. If you're someone who thrives on new challenges, values diversity and wants to make a tangible difference in people's lives, then QIAGEN is the place for you.
  
  
At QIAGEN, every day is an opportunity to make a real-life impact.
  
  
Join us, grow with us, and together, let's shape the future of biological discovery.
  
  
‎
  
  
Position Description
  
  
**Major Tasks**

* Install, maintain, repair and support equipment on all levels (hardware, software and applications)
* Maintain and develop positive relationships with customers
* Utilize relevant databases to input and provide information that will increase effectiveness
* Utilize all available tools such as Service Reports, Spare Part & Service Manuals, ISI Notes, etc
* Assist in the development and maintenance of reference customers
* Assist in Meeting/exceeding sales targets in relation to maintaining high customer satisfaction
* Actively promote and sell Field Service products
* Give active feedback to Sales, Global Product Support and your team/management
* Manage effective available time and resources
* Provide cross-border/district/region support when required
* Positively represent QIAGEN in front of the customer, be a good example!
* Ability to lift ~50lb or 25kgs

Will require work with hazardous substances such as acids and solvents and to work in biological laboratories up to BSL3.
  
  
Position Requirements
  
  

* Technical degree/education in Electronics and reasonable product knowledge within the Life Science industry /markets preferable, Automation experience added advantage
* Preferable minimum of 3-6 years of service and support experience in a comparable position within the after sales service business in the Life Science industry/markets, or equivalent experience maintaining instrumentation
* Proven work experience in developing customer relationships
* Valid driver’s license and Passport and willingness to travel, national and internationally
* Good written and verbal English language communication skills
* Good interpersonal skills
* Ability to work both independently and in a structured working environment
* Willingness to travel for more than 80%.
* Team Player

Personal Requirements
  
  

* Should have strong analytical, problem solving & customer management skills
* Should be willing to learn and pick up information on one own initiative, self-motivated, quick learner and also willing to dissipate and share knowledge
* Self-organized and motivated with the ability to work independently while under guidance from manager.
* Excellent listening, presentation and communication skills at all business levels in both local language and English.

**What We Offer**

* Bonus/Commission
* Local benefits
* Referral Program
* Volunteer Day
* Internal Academy (QIALearn)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Hybrid work (conditional to your role)

Our people are the heartbeat of everything we do. Passion drives us as we push boundaries to innovate and evolve. We inspire with our leadership and make an impact with our actions. We cultivate a collaborative, supportive environment where each individual and team can flourish. We champion accountability and encourage entrepreneurial thinking.
  
  
QIAGEN is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, or disability.

This is an excellent opportunity for individuals looking to start their career in the service engineering field. If you are passionate about providing top-notch service and have a keen interest in technology, we encourage you to apply.

title: IT Support Associate
description:
Gigmos  has successfully disrupted technical customer support in :5 years of its existence. We are now taking things to the next level by building a universe class platform that required us to reimagine how technical support should be delivered. This would be a game changer in the industry with the latest technology embraced and fine-tuned to perfection. It is a complete rethink. If you are a rock star software product business analyst and want to be part of the future then read on and apply.
  
  
  
  
**Job Summary**
The IT Support Engineer will be responsible for providing technical assistance, troubleshooting IT issues, and ensuring smooth functioning of all systems, networks, and hardware across the organization. The role involves responding to user queries, resolving technical problems, and supporting day-to-day IT operations.
  
  
Role Description
  
  

* Provide first-level technical support for hardware, software, and network issues.
* Respond to user queries via phone, email, or ticketing system.
* Install, configure, and maintain desktops, laptops, printers, and other IT equipment.
* Troubleshoot system and network problems; diagnose and resolve hardware/software faults.
* Support installation and configuration of operating systems, applications, and updates.
* Monitor and maintain computer systems, networks, and IT infrastructure.
* Set up new user accounts, email IDs, and access permissions.
* Ensure data backup, antivirus updates, and system security compliance.
* Maintain records of IT assets, maintenance logs, and ticket resolution.
* Assist with onboarding IT setup for new employees.
* Provide remote support when required.
* 2-5 years of experience in IT support or service desk roles.
* Strong knowledge of Windows OS, MS Office, networking fundamentals, and system configurations.
* Hands-on experience with hardware installation and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with LAN/WAN, routers, switches, and Wi-Fi troubleshooting.
* Good understanding of antivirus, security tools, and backups.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and customer service skills.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and work under minimal supervision.

**Skills Required**

* Experience with ticketing tools (e.g., Jira, Freshdesk, ServiceNow).
* Basic understanding of cloud services (Microsoft 365, Google Workspace).
* Knowledge of IT asset management and documentation.

But what really sets us apart are our core values of Hunger, Heart, and Harmony, which guide everything we do, from building relationships with teammates, partners, and clients to making a positive impact in our communities.

title: MES Executive – Implementation & Operations
description:
MES Executive – Implementation & Operations
  

**PREWAL Studio Private Limited**

**Location :**
Gurugram, Haryana

**Employment Type :**
Full-time | On-site

**Experience Required:**
0–2 Years

**Reporting to :**
Ojaswi Kumar (Founders Office)

About PREWAL Studio :

PREWAL Studio Private Limited is a garment manufacturing and export company based in Gurugram, India.

As part of our ongoing efforts to strengthen operational efficiency, transparency, and data-driven decision-making, we are implementing a
**Manufacturing Execution System (MES)**
across our organisation.

We are looking for a smart, technically capable, and proactive individual to help us successfully implement, manage, and optimise this system.

About the Role :

We are hiring an
**MES Executive – Implementation & Operations**
who will be responsible for coordinating the implementation, daily management, monitoring, and effective utilisation of our Manufacturing Execution System across different departments.

The selected candidate will work closely with the Founder's Office, department heads, production teams, and external technology partners to ensure the system functions smoothly and is effectively adopted across the organisation.

This is a hands-on role combining
**technology, manufacturing operations, data analysis, troubleshooting, and cross-departmental coordination**
.

**We are not looking for someone who merely enters data into software. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, understands how systems work, identifies problems, and ensures that technology is being used effectively.**

Key Responsibilities:-
  

**1. MES Implementation & System Management**

* Coordinate the implementation and rollout of the company's Manufacturing Execution System.
* Work closely with external technology partners to support system configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and deployment.
* Understand existing manufacturing workflows and help integrate them into the MES.
* Assist in maintaining system master data, user accounts, access permissions, and configuration settings.
* Act as the primary internal point of contact for MES-related coordination and operational issues.

**2. Daily System Operations & Monitoring**

* Oversee the day-to-day functioning of the MES across relevant departments.
* Monitor whether employees are correctly and consistently using the system.
* Identify missing entries, incorrect data, process gaps, and operational discrepancies.
* Coordinate with department heads to ensure timely updates and accurate information.
* Verify that system records are aligned with actual manufacturing operations.

**3. Technical Support & Troubleshooting**

* Provide first-level technical support to employees using the MES.
* Troubleshoot basic software, login, connectivity, and system-related issues.
* Identify recurring technical problems and coordinate with external support teams for resolution.
* Maintain records of system issues, their status, and corrective actions.
* Follow up proactively to ensure that reported issues are resolved.

**4. Data Management, Analysis & Reporting**

* Monitor system dashboards, production data, and operational reports.
* Analyse information to identify discrepancies, delays, and potential operational bottlenecks.
* Prepare regular MIS reports and operational summaries for management.
* Use Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for data verification, reconciliation, and analysis.
* Highlight critical issues and provide actionable insights to improve operational efficiency.

**5. Training & Cross-Departmental Coordination**

* Assist in training employees on the correct usage of the MES.
* Coordinate with teams across production, cutting, sewing, finishing, quality, stores, merchandising, and other relevant departments.
* Ensure employees understand their respective responsibilities within the system.
* Support the adoption of standardised digital workflows.
* Work with department heads to resolve issues affecting system usage and data accuracy.

**6. Process Improvement & System Optimisation**

* Identify opportunities to improve system utilisation and operational workflows.
* Suggest improvements in data collection, reporting, and process efficiency.
* Help develop simple guidelines and documentation for employees.
* Monitor system adoption and recommend corrective actions wherever necessary.
* Support the company's broader digital transformation initiatives.

Required Qualifications & Skills :-
  

* **0–2 years of professional experience.**
  Smart fresh graduates with strong technical aptitude are encouraged to apply.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Applications, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, Operations, or a related field. Candidates with equivalent practical skills will also be considered.
* Strong computer proficiency and ability to quickly understand unfamiliar software applications.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, filters, lookups, and basic data analysis.
* Strong logical reasoning, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to troubleshoot basic software-related issues independently.
* Good communication, coordination, and follow-up skills.
* Strong attention to detail, organisational ability, and sense of ownership.
* Willingness to work in a manufacturing environment and coordinate regularly with factory-floor employees.

Preferred Qualifications :-
  

The following will be considered significant advantages but are
**not mandatory**
:

* Previous experience or internship exposure in garment manufacturing, apparel exports, textiles, or factory operations.
* Familiarity with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), or other business management software.
* Basic understanding of garment manufacturing processes, production tracking, inventory, and quality management.
* Experience in software implementation, technical support, or system administration.
* Experience preparing MIS reports, dashboards, or analysing operational data.
* Knowledge of advanced Excel, PivotTables, Power BI, SQL, or similar tools.
* Previous experience coordinating with software vendors or training employees on digital systems.

What We Offer :
  

* **Company-wide exposure:**
  Work on a technology initiative involving multiple business functions.
* **Direct management interaction:**
  Work closely with the Founder's Office and departmental leadership.
* **Hands-on learning:**
  Gain practical exposure to manufacturing operations, business systems, and process digitisation.
* **Meaningful responsibility:**
  Help manage a technology platform critical to the company's daily operations.
* **Professional growth:**
  Build valuable experience in manufacturing technology, operational analytics, and digital transformation.

Who Should Apply?

We are particularly interested in candidates who:

* Are naturally curious about technology and enjoy understanding how software works.
* Can learn new systems quickly and independently.
* Enjoy solving technical and operational problems.
* Are comfortable working with both computers and people.
* Are organised, proactive, and detail-oriented.
* Take responsibility for solving problems rather than simply reporting them.
* Want to build a career combining technology, analytics, and manufacturing operations.

**Prior MES experience is not mandatory. Strong technical aptitude, problem-solving ability, and willingness to learn are far more important.**

Interested candidates can apply through
**LinkedIn Easy Apply**
.

About your role Youll join the EDS team as a hands-on engineer focused on day-to-day operations and security hardening across Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD). You will work with platform SMEs and the wider team to deliver BAU tickets, implement hardening baselines, and execute engineering changes. The emphasis is on collaboration and deliverycontributing expert work under established standards and designs rather than owning product roadmaps or leading programs. About you In this role, you will be responsible for efficiently triaging and resolving incidents, service requests, and standard changes across AD/Entra ID, PKI, AD FS, and Quest Active Roles, ensuring adherence to SLAs. You will implement Tier-0/DC hardening, manage GPO governance, and enhance security through Kerberos/LDAP protections and Conditional Access/PIM controls. Your engineering expertise will be pivotal in executing changes based on SME/architect designs, utilising PowerShell and Microsoft Graph for automation and configuration management. You will conduct security remediation using tools like BloodHound/AzureHound and PingCastle, whilst also contributing to monitoring, ops quality, and compliance processes. Collaboration with SMEs and various teams is essential, alongside actively participating in major-incident support and knowledge sharing. Experience & qualifications Microsoft Identity Expertise Strong hands-on experience with Active Directory, Entra ID (Azure AD), AD FS, and Azure AD Connect, including AD 2016/2019 design, troubleshooting, and administration. Privileged Access & Security Solid understanding of AD security (Tier-0/Tier-1, PAWs), lateral movement risks, and secure PAW/jump server rollout. Hardening & Governance Skilled in applying CIS-aligned baselines, securing domain controllers, GPO design, service account hygiene, and identity governance. Cloud Identity & Access Controls Experienced with Conditional Access, MFA, device/risk-based policies, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and secure Entra ID operations at scale. Automation & Tooling Proficient with PowerShell, Graph API, Terraform, KQL, and automation frameworks for audits, enforcement, and remediation; hands-on with BloodHound, PingCastle, and identity monitoring tools. Protocols, Standards & Communication Strong grasp of OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, PKI/AD CS, and Windows security standards; clear communicator with ability to engage both technical and senior stakeholders.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
**Your Role**

Join Megaport, a global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), as we continue to expand. We’re looking for a Technical Support Engineer with a background in networking who is passionate about helping customers and solving technical problems.

You’ll be the first point of contact for our customers, helping resolve technical and account-related issues via phone and web-based support. This is a dynamic, high-growth opportunity to work on real-world networking challenges while collaborating with teams around the world.

You’ll work independently, think creatively to resolve issues, and provide exceptional customer service. This role is ideal for someone looking to grow their career in a global tech company with a strong engineering culture and supportive team environment.

**About Megaport**

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

**Our Team Culture**

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.

We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Provide Technical Support and General Enquiry Customer Service via phone, email, and live chat.
* Meet or exceed support targets (KPIs and SLAs).
* Adhere to operating procedures and policies
* Accurately document all support activities using internal systems.
* Troubleshoot network, portal, and account-related issues using provided tools.
* Focus on resolving issues at first contact and keep customers informed.
* Spot opportunities to help customers improve their services.
* Collaborate with vendors, suppliers, and internal teams to resolve cases.
* Clearly communicate and escalate unresolved technical issues.
* Support inbound sales and general inquiries.
* Think creatively to deliver the best outcome for each customer.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Proven experience in logical networking troubleshooting and solving networking-related issues (three years minimum).
* Studied or completed a degree in IT, Networking, or a related field.
* Fluent in English, both written and verbal.
* Strong customer service skills.
* Able to work independently and collaborate with global teams.
* Detail-oriented, organised, and focused on delivering high-quality results.
* Eager to learn and grow in a fast-paced tech environment.
* Networking certifications (CCNA, CCNP, CWNA, etc.) are a plus.

**Working Hours**

* **Office-based role:**
  Sector 26, Gurgaon Delhi, Gurugram, Haryana
* **Schedule:**

title: Support Engineer - Level 1
description:
**Your Role**

This is an exciting opportunity for a Support Engineer (L1) to solve real-world networking challenges while collaborating with global teams. In this role, you’ll be the first line of response to customer-reported issues, taking ownership of tickets, performing essential diagnostics, and delivering exceptional support experiences. You’ll work both independently and collaboratively in a dynamic environment that values reliability, proactive monitoring, and continuous learning. This position is ideal for a motivated engineer looking to build their career within a global technology company that fosters a strong engineering culture and a supportive, customer-focused team.

As a Support Engineer (L1), your primary responsibility involves efficiently addressing customer concerns communicated through tickets, live chat, and calls, ensuring clear and effective communication to understand and resolve issues promptly. Additionally, you’ll be responsible for the proactive monitoring of our systems and services to identify and rectify potential problems before they impact operations. When faced with complex or high-severity issues, you will gather essential diagnostics and seek guidance from Senior Support Engineers to ensure swift and accurate escalations. Your consistent presence across our shift rotations, ensuring coverage 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, underlines our commitment to providing uninterrupted support and maintaining operational continuity at all times.

**About Megaport**

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

**Our Team Culture**

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.

We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* **Customer Support & Service Excellence**
* Deliver exceptional technical support and customer service via phone, email, and live chat. Process incoming customer calls promptly following ticket submissions to clarify issues, address queries, and ensure accurate understanding.
* Skillfully assess and prioritize tickets based on urgency and operational impact, ensuring critical issues receive immediate attention.
* Maintain high customer satisfaction by resolving issues at the first point of contact whenever possible and keeping customers informed throughout the process.
* Meet or exceed defined KPIs and SLAs while adhering to established operating procedures and policies.
* Strive to independently resolve customer concerns at the first point of contact, escalating complex technical issues to Senior Support Engineers (L2) only when appropriate.
* Manage escalations between global teams (e.g., acting as a bridge between regional support teams) to ensure seamless communication and timely resolution.
* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance customers’ services or improve their overall experience.
* **Service Monitoring & Incident Response**
* Proactively monitor company services, network ports, and peering platforms using alerting and incident response tools to ensure high availability and stability.
* Process alert logs, detect anomalies, and take immediate corrective measures, including opening vendor or customer tickets when necessary.
* Perform system initialization post-server reboots, verifying that traffic restores to pre-reboot baselines and escalating timely if performance inconsistencies occur.
* Create and update detailed incident reports, maintaining accurate, real-time updates on status pages for customer transparency.
* Regularly monitor aggregated content and performance graphs to track trends and identify potential service degradation.
* Process maintenance notifications (internal and external).
* **Knowledge Sharing**
* Contribute to building and maintaining an integrated internal knowledge base by documenting known issues, standard operating procedures, and basic troubleshooting guides.
* Maintain high-quality documentation for designs, configurations, known issues, troubleshooting procedures, and post-incident learnings to enable repeatable outcomes and team uplift.
* Learn and adopt new systems, monitoring applications, and support tools introduced across integrated global operations.

**Your Success Metrics**

* **Installation Efficiency & Quality**
* Track the number, timeliness, and success rate of service installations.
* Maintain a high first-time success rate, minimising rework or follow-up visits.
* Collect and analyse customer feedback post-installation to gauge satisfaction and identify areas for improvement.
* **Ticket & Alert Resolution Performance**
* Achieve a high percentage of received tickets and alerts resolved without further escalation.
* Achieve a strong First Time Resolution rate.
* Ensure essential diagnostic checks and detailed internal notes are completed for 100% of handled tickets within SLA timeframes.
* Ensure that all issues undergo thorough diagnostic checks before being resolved or escalated.
* Maintain strong adherence to KPIs and SLAs for response and resolution times.
* Quickly prioritize, categorize, and process monitoring alerts within target timelines, ensuring service-impacting events are properly communicated and documented.
* Maintain 100% accuracy in incident reports and status page updates to ensure full transparency for customers and internal teams.
* Aim for high first-contact resolution and reduced case reopen rates.

**What We Are Looking For**

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong foundational understanding of network infrastructure and protocols, including LAN/WAN fundamentals (Ethernet, switches, VLANs, IP addressing, ASN, prefixes, and BGP basics).
* Hands-on experience with a variety of network equipment (e.g., Cisco, Juniper, Nokia, MikroTik, and similar platforms).
* Good understanding of networking protocols, including MPLS, OSPF, BGP, and other advanced routing protocols.
* Familiarity with network hardware platforms and tools used in technical support and network monitoring operations.
* Proven experience in logical troubleshooting and resolving networking issues (minimum of three years).

**Customer Support & Problem-Solving**

* Exceptional ability to assess, prioritise, and resolve customer issues efficiently while maintaining clear and professional communication.
* Strong customer service orientation with a focus on understanding customer needs and delivering effective solutions.
* Proven ability to monitor services proactively, detect anomalies, and take corrective action to maintain stability and reliability.

**Communication & Collaboration**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with global teams while also working independently when required.
* Team-oriented mindset with a focus on cooperation, mutual support, and shared success.
* Strong interpersonal skills to build positive relationships with customers and colleagues across regions.

**Personal Attributes**

* Detail-oriented, organised, and committed to delivering high-quality results.
* Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced technical environment.
* High flexibility and readiness to work in a 24/7 rotational shift environment (including night shifts and weekends).

title: Product Deployment Specialist
description:
P
  
  
**roduct Deployment Specialist – Networking**
**About the Team**
Join a dynamic technology services team responsible for deploying, integrating, and supporting enterprise networking solutions for customers across diverse industry segments. The team focuses on delivering reliable, secure, and scalable network infrastructures leveraging Cisco technologies and industry best practices.
  
  
**Key Purpose of the Job**
The Product Deployment Specialist will be responsible for implementing, managing, and supporting Cisco networking and wireless solutions. The role involves deployment, migration, troubleshooting, optimization, and post-implementation support while ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and network performance.
  
  
**Who We’re Looking For**
We are looking for a hands-on networking professional with strong expertise in Cisco Routing, Switching, Wireless, and Network Access Control technologies. The ideal candidate should have experience in enterprise network deployments, troubleshooting complex environments, and working directly with customers during implementation and support engagements.
  
  
**Your Role**
**Network Deployment & Implementation**

* Deploy and support Cisco Routing, Switching, and Wireless solutions.
* Configure and troubleshoot VLANs, STP, EtherChannel, OSPF, BGP, HSRP, and QoS.
* Implement and manage Cisco Catalyst Switches, ISR/ASR Routers, Catalyst 9800 Wireless LAN Controllers, and Cisco Access Points.
* Execute network upgrades, migrations, cutovers, and health check activities.

**Security & Access Control**

* Integrate networking solutions with Cisco ISE.
* Configure and support 802.1X authentication, TACACS+, and Security Group Tag (SGT)-based segmentation.
* Ensure network access control and policy compliance across enterprise environments.

**Monitoring & Optimization**

* Monitor and manage network infrastructure using Cisco Catalyst Center, Cisco Spaces, and other network management tools.
* Diagnose and resolve performance, connectivity, and wireless issues.
* Recommend improvements to optimize network availability and performance.

**Documentation & Customer Support**

* Prepare High-Level Design (HLD), Low-Level Design (LLD), implementation plans, and as-built documentation.
* Provide post-deployment support and technical assistance to customers.
* Collaborate with internal teams and customer stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.

**Technical Competencies**

* Cisco Routing & Switching
* Cisco Wireless (Catalyst 9800 WLC, Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 Access Points)
* OSPF, BGP, VLANs, HSRP, QoS
* Cisco ISE & Network Access Control (NAC)
* 802.1X, TACACS+, SGT-based Segmentation
* Cisco Catalyst Center & Cisco Spaces
* Network Monitoring & Troubleshooting
* SD-WAN (Preferred)

**Behavioral Skills**

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
* Customer-centric approach and stakeholder management
* Effective communication and documentation skills
* Ability to work independently and manage deployment activities
* Strong collaboration and teamwork mindset
* Willingness to travel for customer implementations when required

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* Cisco certifications such as CCNA, CCNP Enterprise, or equivalent will be an added advantage.
* Experience in enterprise networking deployment and support environments.

title: Technical Services Engineer
description:
MongoDB’s mission is to empower innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries by unleashing the power of software and data. We enable organizations of all sizes to easily build, scale, and run modern applications by helping them modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our industry-leading developer data platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud database and is available in more than 115 regions across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. Atlas allows customers to build and run applications anywhere—on premises, or across cloud providers. With offices worldwide and over 175,000 new developers signing up to use MongoDB every month, it’s no wonder that leading organizations, like Samsung and Toyota, trust MongoDB to build next-generation, AI-powered applications.
  
  
MongoDB Technical Services Engineers use their exceptional problem solving and customer service skills, along with their deep technical experience, to advise customers and to solve their complex MongoDB problems. Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem - database server, drivers, cloud, and infrastructure. This also includes services such as Atlas (database as a service), or Cloud Manager (which helps customers with automation, backup and monitoring of their MongoDB systems). Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork, and a great sense of humor to help our customers be successful with MongoDB.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. The position will be based in our Gurugram office. The standard work week will be Sunday to Thursday, every week.
  
  
Cool things you’ll do
  
  
You'll be working alongside our largest customers, solving their complex challenges - resolving questions on architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between. You'll be an expert resource on best practices in running MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You'll be an advocate for customers' needs - interfacing with our product management and development teams on their behalf. And you'll contribute to internal projects, including software development of support tools for performance, benchmarking, and diagnostics.
  
  
What you need
  
  
You should have 5+ years of proven experience, we consider all candidates with an eye for those who are self-taught, insatiably curious, and multi-faceted.
  
  
The ideal candidates should have strong technical experience in more than one of the following areas
  
  

* Systems engineering experience, including Linux performance, memory management, I/O tuning, configuration, security, networking, clusters, and troubleshooting
* Understand core Kubernetes concepts, including containers, namespaces, custom resources and multi-cluster deployments
* Should have a good understanding of Networking concepts and protocols (DNS, TCP/IP, SSL/TLS, etc.)
* Storage engineering experience, including NAS, SAN, SSD, multi-pathing, and caching
* Experience building and maintaining complex mission-critical production database systems
* Broad awareness of customer workloads and use cases, including performance, availability, and scalability
* Experience analyzing issues holistically, from the application tier through the database, down to the storage
* Be able to read code, and basic coding/scripting ability in one or more languages: Java, Python, Ruby, C, C++, C#, Javascript, node.js, Go, etc.
* Desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills

If you have an operations background, we prefer experience administering large-scale production environments, including hardware, operating systems (e.g. Linux, Windows), networks (including firewalls and load balancers), as well as cloud-based resources (e.g. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform).
  
  
You should possess a genuine desire to help people, the ability to think on your feet and remain calm under pressure while solving problems in real-time. There’s a lot to learn, so the desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills is paramount. We work in a collaborative team environment, so a willingness and ability to get help from team members when required, and good judgment to know when to seek help, is essential. We also aim to have diverse technical backgrounds and therefore different subject matter expertise is welcome.
  
  
*You do not need to have prior experience with MongoDB. We can teach you that!*
Bonus Points
  
  

* Experience managing large scale databases (e.g. RDBMS, NoSQL)
* Experience with authentication systems such as LDAP, Kerberos, AD
* Experience using or managing MongoDB
* Experience using distributed version control systems, and in particular git
* Experience using any cloud services stack such as AWS, Azure or GCP
* Experience with virtualization, Docker, Kubernetes (including CLI), ability to inspect resource / container status using relevant utilities and commands

Success Measures
  
  

* In 3 months, you’ll have gained a deep understanding of MongoDB and its ecosystem. You will complete New Hire Training.
* In 6 months, you will be comfortable working frontline with our customers. You will also complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam.
* In 12 months, you will work on gaining expertise to be a part of a technical experts group within MongoDB and will be helping your peer engineers in advance diagnostics. Also, you will be encouraged to handle technical escalations independently.

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: SharePoint - OneDrive And Power Platform Operations - Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**SharePoint ,OneDrive & Power Platform Operations/ Engineer**
In our globalizing economy the availability of skills and expertise is becoming more and more distributed. Within the Compute Services – SharePoint, OneDrive & Power Platform Operations and engineering team, we enable EY professionals to meet the increasing pace of business change by delivering productivity and collaboration solutions that empower them to work together where they want and how they want.
  
  
**EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have over 300,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
**EY Technology**
supports our technology needs through three business units:
  
  

* Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
* Enterprise Technology (ET) – ET supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the most affordable possible cost for quality services. ET will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
* Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

**The opportunity**
The SharePoint Operations Engineer is part of a global SharePoint team in a large, complex, and multinational environment. They have expert knowledge in SharePoint (both Cloud and On-Prem). The individual will be providing Level 3 Operational/Engineering support for areas involving SharePoint Online, with a good understanding of SPO and associated technologies, SharePoint On-Prem, MS Teams, OneDrive for Business, and other M365 services.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* In-depth knowledge of SharePoint, OneDrive and Power platform its features, and related M365 services.
* Experience in installing and configuring SharePoint 2016,2019 & SE.
* Good troubleshooting skills in both sharepoint on-prem (2016/SE) along with SPO.
* Advanced experience with Microsoft PowerShell scripting & automation.
* Intermediate to advanced knowledge of CSOM, MSMQ & Provider Hosted Apps (PHA).
* Intermediate experience with continuous integration systems.
* Understanding of multiple access and authentication models such as NTLM, Kerberos, Claims-based, ADFS, SSL, card services, TMG, UAG, etc
* Knowledge of troubleshooting tools and techniques related to networks and systems i.e. remote access tools, Windows Support tools, connectivity tests, etc
* Detailed understanding of both Classic and Modern SharePoint functionality including Lists, Document Libraries, Pages, Search, Permissions, and Settings
* In-depth support knowledge and experience in providing 24/7 support for SharePoint
* In-depth knowledge in troubleshooting SharePoint end user/client issues.
* In-depth knowledge in SharePoint permissions, webparts, lists, views and any other site level issues.
* Expert knowledge in Incident management, Service requests, Change requests and ServiceNow processes for SP support.
* In-depth knowledge on SharePoint support workflow, level 1, level 2 and level 3. This role is for Level 3 support.
* Capability to help customer to fix the issue and/or create tickets for Microsoft for further troubleshooting.
* In-depth knowledge on PowerShell scripting and automation experience using scripts.
* Desirable - Knowledge in deploying SharePoint solutions, updating automation scripts and html pages.
* Desirable – Knowledge of Power Platform products, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI
* Experience with SCRUM/Agile development process is a plus.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
How your skills and experience will make an impact:
  
  
**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* History of working credibly within teams and delivering high level of support services on the SharePoint platform
* Proactively anticipates service issues before they occur and able to make recommendations around resolution.
* Proactively monitor outages within a small group or wider group.
* Ability to communicate platform capabilities to customer and provide appropriate recommendations.
* Adapts personal communication style to the style of others, develops rapport and stays calm under pressure or escalating issues using advanced oral and written English communication skills.
* Strong verbal and written skills including strong cross-cultural communication and the ability to draft effective communications
* Ability to work with people in a variety of cultures, countries and time zones
* Utilizes all aspects of Emotional Intelligence to navigate the interactions and complexities of the business environment and drive leadership performance in oneself and in others.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* This role does not have a direct supervision responsibility but should proactively own tasks/issues and drive towards resolution independently.
* A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related discipline, or equivalent work experience required
* 2-5 years of experience in support role with at least last 1 year in SharePoint support.

**What We Look For**

* Passionate, committed and determined
* Candidate must be flexible to the demands of the services we provide and any project to which they are assigned. The role may require out of office hours work.
* This role is for 24/7 support and requires working in night shift periodically.

**What Working At EY Offers**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Engineer, Virtualization
description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
  
  
At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.
  
  
**We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.**
**AHEAD is searching for a Senior Virtualization Engineer to be a part of our Managed Services team.**
Candidates will be primarily responsible for the overall health, stability, security, performance, and lifecycle management of virtualization and compute platforms in our managed services customer environments. Candidates will serve as a senior member of the Managed Services Virtualization team, providing tier 3 technical leadership for virtualization technologies, complex incidents, platform improvements, and customer outcomes. The role participates in 24x7 operations and an on-call rotation. The ideal candidate should be customer focused, an effective communicator, self-initiating, accountable, and able to perform most tasks without direct oversight.
  
  
**Principle Duties And Responsibilities**

* Provide enterprise-level operational support for incident, problem, change, request, and event-management activities
* Lead complex and escalated virtualization incidents, including high-risk, recurring, cross-domain, vendor-dependent, and platform-impacting issues
* Provide technical leadership during P1 incidents by assessing impact, coordinating technical actions, documenting risks and decisions, and driving resolution through closure
* Serve as a subject matter expert and escalation point for virtualization and compute technologies, addressing technical events and requests needing additional resources or urgent attention
* Assess customer environments for performance, capacity, configuration, design, resilience, security, and supportability issues; propose and implement resolutions
* Provide architectural oversight and validate that proposed changes, designs, and remediation plans align with vendor-supported practices, client standards, capacity, resiliency, security, and service scope
* Work across networking, storage, operating-system, security, monitoring, automation, and application teams to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues
* Work with vendors and hardware partners to resolve virtualization and compute issues, coordinate escalations, and implement supported resolutions
* Own or contribute to problem-management records, corrective actions, preventive actions, post-incident reviews, and technical root-cause analyses for recurring or systemic issues
* Lead or support platform lifecycle activities, including upgrade readiness, compatibility validation, capacity planning, end-of-support and end-of-life assessments, patch planning, firmware coordination, and VCF lifecycle management
* Maintain accurate client architecture, access, configuration, monitoring, hardware, firmware, inventory, and maintenance documentation. Reconcile documentation against authoritative platform, CMDB, monitoring, and inventory sources
* Ensure that clients' infrastructure is healthy, stable, secure, documented, and configured with accepted technical best practices
* Perform recurring operational-risk reviews and identify opportunities to improve platform stability, supportability, monitoring coverage, security posture, automation, and service consistency
* Support annual architecture, capacity, lifecycle, and standard-operating-procedure reviews, and provide technical inputs for quarterly business reviews or other strategic client reviews
* Own the technical execution of assigned client onboarding and offboarding activities, including access validation, monitoring coverage, vendor access, initial documentation, known-issue identification, and EoS/EoL review
* Provide clear technical context, risk, impact, dependencies, recommended actions, and next steps to Client Success Managers and customer technical contacts. Business-impacting or scope-related customer communications should be coordinated through the appropriate Client Success Manager
* Participate in 24x7 operations and the on-call rotation, including major incidents and planned maintenance activities as scheduled
* Complete training and certification as assigned to further skills and knowledge
* Mentor L2 engineers, improve escalation quality, review technical work when assigned, and contribute to standards, runbooks, knowledge articles, training, and continuous-improvement initiatives

**Qualifications/ Technology Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (Unique education, specialized experience, skills, knowledge, training, or certification may be substituted)
* 10+ yrs of experience with virtualization technologies and enterprise infrastructure operations

+ Experience with VMware vSphere/VVF required
+ Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) required
+ Experience with Nutanix AHV required
+ Experience with Microsoft Hyper-V preferred
+ Experience with Red Hat OpenShift Virtualization, including virtual-machine lifecycle management, networking, storage integration, and operational troubleshooting

* 5+ years of hands-on experience with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) deployment, configuration, lifecycle management, and operational support

+ Proficiency in VCF lifecycle management, including automated deployment, patching, and upgrades using SDDC Manager
+ Experience with VCF workload domains, including VI workload domains and NSX-T network virtualization
+ Knowledge of VCF validated designs and reference architectures for hybrid-cloud implementations
+ Experience with VCF integration with public-cloud services (VMware Cloud on AWS, Azure VMware Solution, Google Cloud VMware Engine) preferred
+ Experience with VCF's automated deployment and configuration of vSphere, vSAN, NSX, and vRealize Suite or Aria components
+ Demonstrated ability to manage converged infrastructure through VCF's unified platform spanning compute, storage, networking, and security

* 10+ yrs of experience with operational administration of enterprise IT systems
* 10+ yrs of experience with performance and infrastructure monitoring tools (LogicMonitor, Elastic, or comparable platforms)
* 5+ yrs of experience with an enterprise ITSM system. ServiceNow preferred
* Experience with Cisco UCS and Dell hardware systems required

+ Familiarity with Dell PowerFlex/PowerStore/VxRail preferred

* Operating System skills with Windows and Linux preferred
* Understanding of PowerShell and PowerCLI with ability to create and utilize scripts for administration, troubleshooting, reporting, and automation required
* Managed Services or consulting experience required
* VMware Certified Professional certification required; VMware Certified Advanced Professional certification preferred
* ITILv4 certification preferred

**Qualifications: Soft Skills**

* Advanced technical troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities
* Approach projects, changes, and problems with a “security first” mindset
* Superior customer service and training skills
* Possess a strong sense of urgency and ability to set priorities during normal operations and high-impact events
* Ability to work without direct supervision and make sound technical decisions
* Team-oriented collaborator willing to share knowledge and experience
* Ability to communicate technical risk, business impact, dependencies, decisions, and recommended actions clearly to engineers, managers, CSMs, vendors, and customer technical stakeholders
* Ability to remain accountable for coordination and follow-through until the next owner formally accepts an escalation
* Ability to balance customer requests with platform capacity, resiliency, security, contractual scope, change control, and operational risk
* Excellent written and verbal interpersonal skills and ability to build and maintain collaborative and positive working relationships at all levels
* Ability to effectively interact with all levels of business via phone, written communication, and in person
* Skilled in achieving results in a customer centric environment
* Self-motivated, able to work in a fast-paced 24x7 managed-services environment

**Why AHEAD**
Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.
  
  
We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.

title: Technical Program Executive in Gurgaon
description:
We are looking for a curious, enthusiastic fresher to join our Gurgaon headquarters as a Technical Program Executive. You will help bring new clients onto the Zippee platform and make sure their systems connect smoothly with ours, working alongside Product, Engineering, Operations, clients, and technology partners. You do not need to be a software developer, and you do not need prior work experience. If you are curious about how apps and systems talk to each other, enjoy staying organized, and like solving problems, we will teach you the rest. You will be mentored by experienced team members and learn on real client projects from day one.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Help onboard new clients and support implementation projects from requirement gathering through go-live.
* Coordinate with Product, Engineering, Operations, clients, and technology partners to keep milestones on track.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT): prepare test cases, coordinate testing, log issues, and follow them until closed.
* Assist during production deployments and post-go-live activities.
* Learn how orders move between systems (order management, warehouse, logistics, partner platforms) and help spot where things get stuck.
* Work with technical teams to find and resolve integration issues, with guidance from senior members.
* Prepare project documents, simple process flows, trackers, and regular status updates.
* Explain technical issues in simple language to clients and business teams, and pass client requirements clearly to engineers.
* Track risks, open issues, and action items, and follow up with the right people on time.
* Suggest ideas to improve how we onboard clients and run integrations.

About Company: Zippee is India's 1st quick commerce logistics platform for e-commerce brands. Brands can connect their online stores to Zippee & kickstart quick commerce via our network of dark stores & last-mile fleets across India. This approach significantly improves customer loyalty, logistics costs, and RTOs. We're backed by VCs & founders of India's largest unicorns.

title: IT Engineer II, ITSE Solutions
description:
At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.
  
  
Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25-year-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.
  
  
While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are seeking a highly skilled ServiceNow ITSM Solution Engineer to serve as a critical bridge between business needs and technical implementation. In this role, you will partner closely with stakeholders, product teams, and service organizations to understand complex business challenges and translate them into scalable, cost-effective ServiceNow solutions. This position plays a key role in shaping solution design, ensuring alignment with ITSM product strategies, and delivering measurable value through a customer-centric approach.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings a strong blend of consulting mindset, technical expertise, and business acumen—capable of gathering and prioritizing requirements, architecting tailored solutions, and producing clear, actionable design documentation. You will be responsible for guiding solution delivery from concept through implementation, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, ITIL best practices, and platform capabilities.
  
  
As a trusted advisor, the ServiceNow Solution Engineer will collaborate across cross-functional teams to drive successful project outcomes, optimize IT service workflows, and enable digital transformation. This role requires the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, while maintaining a focus on delivering intuitive, high-quality user experiences that enhance operational efficiency and long-term platform scalability.
  
  
**Key Functions**

* Requirements Engineering: Actively listening to customers to uncover, analyze, and document technical needs and pain points.
* Solution Design: Creating customized technical blueprints, architectures, and integration plans.
* Technical Consulting: Evaluating feasibility, researching best practices, and proposing cost-effective solutions.
* Product Demonstration/POC: Developing proof-of-concept models to visualize value and reduce risk for buyers.
* Documentation: Creating detailed technical specifications, proposals, and project documentation.
* Communicate with internal and external stakeholders in an open and timely manner, providing all needed information and support.
* Demonstrations & Proof of Concepts (POCs) to Minimum Viable Product (MVP): Tailoring product demos and developing POCs to demonstrate how the solution solves the client's specific problems.
* Prepares and presents comprehensive technical and administrative solutions to interpret requirements, identify alternatives, and recommendations-based experience and other findings.
* Product Feedback Loop: Working with internal product and engineering teams to relay client requirements and influence product improvements.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.
* This position will collaborate with multiple internal teams to design integrations with interfacing processes, enabling automated capabilities with procurement, finance, and third parties.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Convert business requirements into technical solutions—covering data models, workflows, integrations, and security.
* Ensure platform scalability, resilience, and compliance with security and regulatory requirements.
* Design and develop and engineer robust ServiceNow architectures aligned with business objectives and IT strategies while adhering to the product line model and SAFe Agile controls/process.
* Communication with peers and upper management, as appropriate, relative to issues, problems, and general status
* Leverage insights to advise on actionable areas for improvement or other actions to ensure operational value is maintained

**Additional/Secondary Responsibilities**

* Contributing to the development and refinement of the ITSM product line roadmap, management policies and schedules as needed for future enhancements.
* Engaging with internal and external resources to ensure clarification, changes, resolution, are addressed.
* Resolve stakeholder related issues and escalate to manager or Director of Strategy and Value Optimization as appropriate.

**Required Qualifications:**
Bachelor’s degree in IT or business equivalent
  
  
**Technical Expertise**

* Strong background in software, hardware, or systems architecture.
* Must have worked in similar environments within the last two years

**Certifications**

* ITIL Foundation
* ITSM Foundation
* ServiceNow certifications CTA, CSA; other

**Experience**

* Three or more years of experience supporting development and management of IT services relative to similar roles.
* Demonstrated capabilities with ITSM, ITIL and SAFeAgile factory models.
* Demonstrated success in large scale capability development and deployment.
* Working knowledge of ITIL and ITSM principles
* Understanding of SAFe Agile methodologies and practices, specifically within ServiceNow SPM (Service Portfolio Management) in planning and execution.
* Ability to problem solve issues to resolution
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy and processes
* Highly flexible and adaptable to change
* Proficient in ITSM Foundation and experience with ServiceNow ITOM, ITSM, CMDB, KB etc.
* Microsoft Office and other productivity tools
* Global/international experience or exposure a plus

**Interpersonal Skills**

* Experience working with people and teams across various functions and regions.
* Demonstrated ability to create innovative solutions and think outside the box to solve complex and analytical problems.
* Demonstrated verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills
* Highly flexible and adaptable to change

McCormick & Company is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
As a general policy, McCormick does not offer employment visa sponsorships upon hire or in the future.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

* **Role:**
  Forward Deployed Engineer (Voice & Conversational AI) -
  *Scale Voice & Conversational AI product suite across 0-1, 1-0, 10-100 journeys*
* **Department:**
  Product Management
* **Location:**
  Gurugram. Great, if you have a US travel Visa.
* **Team Stage:**
  Series B
* **Key Partners:**
  Product, Engineering, GTM, Onboarding, Customer Success
* **Work hours:**
  US hours (6pm IST onwards), frequent US travel

**About Spyne**

Spyne is building the AI operating system for automotive retail. It started with visual merchandising and has expanded into conversational AI. Spyne helps dealers move inventory faster, respond to buyers instantly, and run more of the dealership stack with AI. Founded by operators from Amazon, Cox, and OYO, Spyne has grown 30x in under three years and now powers 1,500+ dealerships across the US. Its products, Studio AI and Vini AI, are coming together into a full-stack Retail AI platform for modern dealerships.

* Rooftops live: 2,000+
* Growth: 2.5 to 3x a year for 3 consecutive years
* Revenue from the US: 80%+
* Net revenue retention: above 110%
* Integrations: 70+ across CRM, DMS, inventory, service and finance
* Team: 200+, primarily India-based
* Capital raised: $25M+ from Accel, Vertex Ventures and Storm Ventures

**The role**

Spyne sells AI to US franchise auto dealers. Vini AI is our voice agent for the dealer BDC: it handles sales inbound, sales outbound, and service inbound calls that a dealership would otherwise staff with people.

This role owns the technical side of making a dealer successful with Vini, from the first sales conversation to a live, performing deployment. You sit between our Sales, Onboarding, and Success teams as the person who can answer the hard product questions, configure the agent for a specific rooftop, debug a call flow at 11pm Central, and tell a GM why their service line is now booking 30% more appointments.

We have people who sell, onboard, and manage accounts. You are the one who makes the technology work for each customer across all three stages. You sit inside the product org. That's deliberate. You're the shortest path between a dealer who's blocked and the Product and Tech teams who can unblock them, and you're the field signal that decides what Vini builds next

**What you’ll own?**

*Pre-sales and sales closure*

* Join sales calls and demos as the technical authority on Vini. Answer dealer questions about call handling, integrations, data, and accuracy that an AE can't
* Run proof-of-concept setups for prospects. Configure a working agent against the dealer's real call scenarios so they hear it before they sign
* Map each prospect's BDC workflows (which calls, which CRM, which DMS, which phone system) and tell Sales what's straightforward and what's hard
* Build the technical knowledge base that lets AEs answer common questions without you, so your time goes to the deals that actually need it.

*Implementation and onboarding*

* Own the technical onboarding once a dealer signs. Connect Vini to their CRM, DMS, and telephony, configure the three call workflows, and set up routing, scripts, and escalation rules for their store
* Get the agent from copilot to autopilot on the dealer's timeline. Tune prompts, intents, and call logic against real calls until the dealer trusts it to run unattended
* Train the dealer's staff and BDC managers on how Vini fits their day, what to expect, and how to read its output
* Cut onboarding time. Find the steps that slow every deployment and turn them into repeatable setup, templates, or product requests

*Post-onboarding success*

* Become the subject matter expert the Success team brings in when an account has a technical problem they can't solve: a drop in answer rate, a workflow that needs reconfiguring after the dealer changes process, a new integration
* Monitor live deployments. Watch call performance, catch failures before the dealer does, and fix the agent or the config
* Expand accounts. Move dealers from one workflow to three, from one rooftop to a group, by proving Vini works on the calls they were nervous about

**What we expect?**

* 4+ years as an engineer, solutions engineer, FDE, or implementation engineer, with real time in front of customers. You've shipped code and you've also sat across from a frustrated user and fixed their problem live
* Comfort with APIs, integrations, and reading logs to find why something broke. You don't need to be a senior backend engineer, but you debug without waiting for the eng team
* Product sense. You can look at a pile of customer problems and tell which ones are config, which are training, and which are real product gaps. You write requests engineers want to pick up
* Experience working directly with Product and Engineering teams: filing well-scoped issues, sitting in on prioritization, and pushing for customer-facing fixes without burning the relationship
* Experience with at least one of: voice AI or conversational AI, telephony or contact-center systems, or CRM/DMS integrations
* The judgment to talk to a dealership GM and a Spyne engineer in the same hour and translate between them
* Willingness to work US-overlapping hours and travel to the US often, sometimes for a week or more at a time. Dealers want to see a person on site during go-live
* A bias toward owning the outcome. When a deployment stalls, you don't hand it off. You find out why and you fix it

**Bonus:**

* You've built or deployed production voice agents and know where they fail: latency, interruption handling, transfers, intent confusion
* You've owned a product feedback loop before: collecting field signal, turning it into specs, and seeing your requests through to shipped features
* You've been the first FDE or early implementation hire somewhere and built the playbook from nothing

title: Production Monitoring Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**
The Monitoring Engineer is a hands‑on technical role responsible for the day‑to‑day administration, configuration, and maintenance of enterprise monitoring platforms, with a primary focus on New Relic.
  
  
The role supports the delivery of effective monitoring and observability across FNZ platforms by implementing agreed monitoring standards, maintaining tooling health, and ensuring monitoring configurations remain current and reliable.
  
  
This position works closely with Monitoring Architects, Senior Analysts, Production Support, and Engineering teams. Monitoring requirements, strategy, and design direction are driven by Architects and senior operational stakeholders; the Monitoring Engineer is responsible for implementing, maintaining, and supporting those requirements effectively.
  
  
The Monitoring Engineer plays a key role in ensuring monitoring tooling enables timely issue detection, efficient incident investigation, and improved platform reliability.
  
  
**Team Responsibilities**
The current climate has no tolerance for slow performance, broken functionality or downtime with a need for constant and clear visibility into the end-to-end performance of our production applications.
  
  
Application Monitoring – developing new and innovative solutions to our monitoring requirements.
  
  
Stakeholder Communication – ensuring all monitoring solutions are embedded into production BAU and handed over to our operational support teams.
  
  
Project management – Manage our monitoring solutions from design, build, test, implementation and handover. Our team follows a Devops model so we will maintain our tooling and build for any upgrades, defects or improvements after go live.

**Experience Required**

Minimum 5 years of experience in Monitoring, Production Support, Platform Operations, or similar technical roles.

Experience maintaining monitoring agents, integrations, dashboards, and alert configurations.

Good technical troubleshooting skills and a methodical problem‑solving approach.
  
  
Strong attention to detail when implementing and maintaining tooling configurations.

**Experience Preferred**
