Exposure to managing monitoring configuration at scale, including use of Terraform or similar tools.
  
  
Understanding of OTEL standards.
  
  
Experience working with operational tooling such as ServiceNow, PagerDuty, or Splunk.
  
  
Experience supporting monitoring in cloud, virtualised, or distributed environments.
  
  
Basic familiarity with application technologies such as .NET, APIs, SQL Server, or microservices.
  
  
Experience working in regulated or enterprise environments with formal change processes.
  
  
**About FNZ**
*FNZ is committed to opening up wealth so that everyone, everywhere can invest in their future on their terms. We know the foundation to do that already exists in the wealth management industry, but complexity holds firms back.*
*We created wealth’s growth platform to help. We provide a global, end-to-end wealth management platform that integrates modern technology with business and investment operations. All in a regulated financial institution.*
*We partner with the world’s leading financial institutions, with over US$2.4 trillion in assets on platform (AoP).
  
  
Together with our clients, we empower nearly 30 million people across all wealth segments to invest in their future.*

title: Infrastructure Engineer II
description:
**Job Description**
The Infrastructure Patching & Security Engineering team ensures the security, stability, compliance, and operational resilience of enterprise infrastructure platforms through proactive patch management, vulnerability remediation, security hardening, automation, and continuous improvement.
  
  
The team is responsible for maintaining secure and compliant Red Hat Linux, Windows environments by implementing enterprise patching strategies, addressing security vulnerabilities, reducing infrastructure risk, and ensuring adherence to organizational security standards.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Infrastructure Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Windows Server, VMware, system administration, OS patching, vulnerability management, infrastructure security, automation, and scripting. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing enterprise-wide patching operations, remediating security vulnerabilities, troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, and driving automation to improve patch compliance and operational efficiency.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**OS Patching & Infrastructure Security Operations**

* Plan, coordinate, execute, and manage enterprise-wide operating system patching across Red Hat Linux and Windows infrastructure.
* Own end-to-end patch management activities, including patch assessment, planning, testing, deployment, validation, reporting, and remediation.
* Manage monthly, emergency, and out-of-band security patching cycles across production and non-production environments.
* Implement security patches, critical updates, kernel upgrades, and operating system fixes in accordance with enterprise security policies.
* Identify and remediate missing patches, outdated software packages, and infrastructure security vulnerabilities.
* Troubleshoot patch installation failures, dependency conflicts, repository issues, reboot failures, and post-patching system issues.
* Ensure patching activities are executed within approved maintenance windows with minimal business disruption.
* Develop patch rollback, recovery, and contingency procedures to minimize operational risks.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, application, cybersecurity, and change management teams to ensure timely patch deployment and compliance.

**Red Hat Linux, Windows & VMware Administration**

* Build, configure, administer, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise Red Hat Enterprise Linux and Windows Server environments.
* Perform Linux patching using YUM, DNF, RPM, Red Hat Satellite, and related patch management tools.
* Manage Windows Server patching using Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), WSUS, or equivalent enterprise patching platforms.
* Support VMware ESXi and vCenter patching, upgrades, lifecycle management, and security remediation.
* Troubleshoot Linux kernel issues, package dependencies, system services, boot failures, filesystem issues, and OS performance degradation.
* Administer Windows Server infrastructure, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and Windows Update services.
* Perform server health checks, pre-patching readiness assessments, and post-patching validation.
* Support operating system upgrades, end-of-life remediation, server migrations, and infrastructure modernization.

**Vulnerability Management & Security Remediation**

* Partner with cybersecurity and vulnerability management teams to identify, assess, prioritize, and remediate infrastructure vulnerabilities.
* Analyze vulnerability scan results from tools such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or equivalent enterprise security platforms.
* Remediate critical and high-severity vulnerabilities within defined security SLAs.
* Investigate vulnerabilities associated with operating systems, software packages, system configurations, and infrastructure components.
* Implement security hardening recommendations based on CIS benchmarks, vendor guidance, and enterprise security standards.
* Address security findings related to outdated packages, insecure protocols, weak configurations, unsupported operating systems, and missing security patches.
* Support vulnerability exception management, risk acceptance processes, and remediation tracking.
* Coordinate with application owners and infrastructure teams to resolve vulnerabilities requiring application compatibility testing or planned downtime.
* Maintain accurate vulnerability remediation records, compliance evidence, and audit documentation.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce vulnerability exposure and infrastructure security risk.

**Patching Automation & Scripting**

* Design, develop, and maintain automation solutions for enterprise infrastructure patching and security remediation.
* Automate Linux and Windows patch deployment, patch validation, compliance checks, and operational reporting.
* Develop automation scripts using Python, Bash, PowerShell, and Ansible.
* Implement Ansible playbooks for Linux patching, server configuration, security hardening, and vulnerability remediation.
* Automate patch readiness checks, server reboot coordination, service validation, and post-patching health checks.
* Integrate patching workflows with enterprise automation, orchestration, and IT service management platforms.
* Develop reusable scripts and automation frameworks to reduce manual intervention and improve patching consistency.
* Troubleshoot automation failures and continuously optimize patch deployment workflows.
* Identify opportunities to improve patch success rates, reduce patching cycle times, and increase infrastructure compliance through automation.

**Patch Compliance, Governance & Reporting**

* Track and maintain infrastructure patch compliance across Linux, Windows, and VMware platforms.
* Monitor patch deployment status, remediation progress, patch failures, and outstanding security vulnerabilities.
* Generate patch compliance dashboards, vulnerability remediation reports, and operational metrics.
* Ensure infrastructure patching activities align with enterprise security policies, regulatory requirements, and internal audit standards.

**Qualifications**
**Required Experience & Technical Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience managing enterprise-wide operating system patching and vulnerability remediation across large-scale infrastructure environments.
* Extensive expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL 7/8/9 or later), including administration, patching, kernel upgrades, troubleshooting, and security hardening.
* Strong hands-on experience with Windows Server 2016/2019/2022 or later, including administration, security updates, patch deployment, and troubleshooting.

* Experience with Windows patch management platforms such as SCCM/MECM, WSUS, or equivalent enterprise tools.
* Strong understanding of vulnerability management processes and remediation using tools such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management using Ansible.
* Hands-on scripting experience using Python, Bash/Shell scripting, and PowerShell.
* Strong understanding of operating system security hardening, CIS benchmarks, vulnerability remediation, and patch compliance.
* Experience managing critical and high-severity security vulnerabilities and meeting defined remediation SLAs.
* Good understanding of enterprise networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, firewalls, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of enterprise storage technologies, filesystems, and infrastructure performance management.

* Strong troubleshooting skills across operating systems, infrastructure security, patching platforms, VMware, networking, and storage.
* Experience supporting large-scale production infrastructure in highly regulated environments.
* Strong communication, documentation, analytical, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Red Hat Satellite, Ansible Automation Platform, Microsoft Configuration Manager, and enterprise patch orchestration solutions.

* Strong troubleshooting knowledge of Outlook and Exchange Online.

* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), MFA, user provisioning, and license management.
* Familiarity with ITSM tools, ticket management, and SLA-based support.
* Good communication, customer service, and troubleshooting skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* PowerShell scripting for Microsoft 365 administration.
* Knowledge of ITIL processes and incident, problem, and change management.
* Experience supporting enterprise users in a corporate IT environment.

Candidate Requirements
  
  

* Candidates must have 4+ years of relevant Microsoft 365/O365 support experience.
* Candidates should be comfortable working in a hybrid model from NCR, Mumbai, or Kolkata.

title: IAM Operations Engineer
description:
As an
**IAM Operations Engineer at Topsoe**
, you will play a key role in the daily operation, monitoring, support, and troubleshooting of our Identity and Access Management (IAM) platform and its integrations.
  
  
Your work will help ensure that identity lifecycle processes and access-management services remain available, reliable, and compliant throughout the employee journey—from
**joiner to mover to leaver**
. You will also help bring IAM platform ownership in-house as we transition responsibilities from our external partner.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Take ownership of the daily operations of Topsoe’s IAM platform and its integrations.
* Monitor platform health, performance, and connections with enterprise systems such as SAP.
* Handle L2/L3 support escalations from the L1 Service Desk and resolve incidents effectively.
* Troubleshoot provisioning, deprovisioning, access-request, and access-review issues.
* Investigate failed or delayed identity transactions and analyze access models and connectors.
* Coordinate complex investigations with development, architecture, application, and infrastructure teams.
* Support testing, deployment, rollback, access reviews, audits, documentation, and continuous improvement.
* You will also help educate L1 support colleagues, improve first-contact resolution, and maintain clear standard operating procedures and knowledge articles.

**What You Will Bring**
You should have more than 3 years of experience in operating IAM platforms and supporting identity lifecycle processes in a structured, service-oriented environment. You are analytical, methodical, and comfortable investigating technical issues with both business and security implications.
  
  
**We Are Looking For**

* Experience operating IAM platforms, preferably SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC).
* A good understanding of provisioning flows, connectors, and identity lifecycle processes.
* Experience with IT Service Management, including incident, problem, and change management.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* The ability to prioritize incidents based on business and security impact.
* Clear documentation skills and experience maintaining operational procedures.
* Basic knowledge of APIs and scripting.

**It Would Be An Advantage If You Have**

* SailPoint certification or a willingness to pursue certification.
* Experience working in a global organization with distributed teams.
* Knowledge of monitoring, alerting, and operational performance management.
* Scripting experience with PowerShell, Python, or similar tools.
* An ITIL Foundation certification.
* Experience supporting access reviews, audit controls, or compliance activities.

**Your new team**
You will join a dedicated internal IAM team of four professionals and help build the foundation for Topsoe’s future IAM operations. Together, the team will take on responsibilities currently managed by our external partner and develop effective ways of working for long-term operational ownership.
  
  
This is an opportunity to contribute to a collaborative and security-focused environment where your work will have a direct impact on Topsoe’s IT landscape.
  
  
**You Will Have The Opportunity To**

* Strengthen Topsoe’s internal IAM capabilities.
* Help ensure reliable identity and access services across the organization.
* Improve operational processes, monitoring, and support practices.
* Support the onboarding and stabilization of new applications.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing and the development of the IAM team.
* Be part of Topsoe’s ongoing digital transformation.

**How You Can Apply**
If you would like to be part of a team of skilled and professional colleagues in an informal organization, please submit your documents in English.
  
  
**Application deadline: 18-10-2026**
.
  
  
You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application – just include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are applying. Please also avoid the use of photos in your CV. Both of these measures are to ensure a fair and unbiased process.
  
  
We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, disability, ethnic background, and geographical location. We encourage individuals from diverse cultures and countries to apply and contribute to our global team.
  
  
To ensure a secure and trustworthy work environment, our recruitment process may include background checks, requests for criminal records, and contact with references.
  
  
*To headhunters: Thank you for your interest in our company. However, we would like to inform you that we have a dedicated internal team managing our recruitment process. We kindly request that you refrain from reaching out to us regarding potential candidates. Thank you for your understanding.*
**About Us**
Topsoe is a leading global provider of advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition.
  
  
Built on decades of scientific research and innovation, we are working with customers and partners to drive energy resiliency and to achieve their sustainability goals.
  
  
We offer world-leading solutions for transforming renewable resources into fuels and chemicals, and we provide technologies needed to produce low-carbon and conventional fuels and chemicals as well as ensuring clean air.
  
  
We were founded in 1940 and are headquartered in Denmark, with around 2,500 employees serving customers all around the globe. To learn more, visit www.topsoe.com.

title: Information Technology Support Assistant
description:

2. Key Roles and Responsibilities

**A. Hardware and Software Support**

* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot desktop computers, laptops, printers, scanners, and other IT equipment.
* Install and update operating systems, applications, antivirus software, and other required programs.
* Diagnose hardware and software issues and ensure timely resolution.
* Maintain an inventory of IT equipment, accessories, and software licences.

**B. Network and Internet Management**

* Monitor and troubleshoot LAN, Wi-Fi, internet connectivity, and network-related issues.
* Coordinate with internet service providers and external IT vendors whenever required.
* Ensure secure and reliable network connectivity across the school campus.

**C. Smart Classrooms and Audio-Visual Equipment**

* Maintain and troubleshoot smart boards, projectors, speakers, microphones, interactive panels, and other classroom equipment.
* Provide technical support during classes, assemblies, meetings, PTMs, workshops, and school events.
* Ensure the proper functioning of audio-visual systems in the auditorium and other designated areas.

**D. Administrative and Academic IT Support**

* Provide technical assistance to the Principal, Vice Principal, coordinators, teachers, and administrative staff.
* Support the functioning of school management software, ERP systems, online portals, and digital attendance systems.
* Assist with printing, scanning, data backup, document sharing, and other technical requirements.
* Provide technical assistance for online meetings, presentations, examinations, and school-related activities.

**E. Data Security and Maintenance**

* Ensure regular data backups and maintain the confidentiality of school records.
* Follow appropriate cybersecurity practices and protect systems against viruses and unauthorized access.
* Maintain records of IT complaints, troubleshooting activities, repairs, and preventive maintenance.
* Ensure the safe handling and proper use of school IT equipment.

**F. Technical Support and Coordination**

* Attend IT-related complaints promptly and maintain a record of their resolution.
* Conduct routine inspections of computer labs, classrooms, offices, and other IT facilities.
* Coordinate with vendors for equipment repairs, installations, and maintenance.
* Report major technical issues, equipment damage, and recurring problems to the concerned authority.
* Perform any other IT-related duties assigned by the school management.

3. Educational Qualifications

* Diploma or Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Applications, or a related field.
* Relevant technical certifications will be an added advantage.

4. Experience

* Preferably 1–3 years of experience in IT support, hardware and networking, or technical maintenance.
* Experience working in a school or educational institution will be preferred.

5. Required Technical Skills

* Knowledge of computer hardware, software installation, and troubleshooting.
* Basic networking knowledge, including LAN, Wi-Fi, routers, and switches.
* Familiarity with Windows operating systems, printers, scanners, and antivirus software.
* Knowledge of projectors, smart boards, interactive panels, and audio-visual systems.
* Basic understanding of data backup, cybersecurity, and IT inventory management.

6. Essential Competencies

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.
* Patience and a service-oriented approach while assisting teachers and staff.
* Ability to priorities and resolve technical issues efficiently.
* Punctuality, discipline, confidentiality, and professional conduct.
* Willingness to provide technical support during school events and other activities as required.

7. General Terms and Conditions

* The candidate must maintain the confidentiality of all school-related information and data.
* School equipment must be handled responsibly and used only for authorized purposes.
* All IT-related complaints and maintenance activities must be documented appropriately.
* The employee must follow school policies, working hours, and instructions issued by the school management.

**Note:**
The employee shall perform all IT-related responsibilities assigned by the school management to ensure the smooth and uninterrupted functioning of the school campus.

title: Analyst, TSG Product Management
description:
**Company Profile**

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefining industries. The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.
  
  
**What Makes Us Great Place To Work**
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. We are currently the #1 ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list and have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list since its founding in 2009.
  
  
Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don't happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Analyst, TSG Product Management, is assigned to one or a few products. The Analyst is responsible for responding to user inquiries and troubleshooting issues, performing routine updates, and validating changes through testing. This role gathers product insights by tracking key metrics, monitoring usage and adoption, and collecting user feedback through periodic surveys. The Analyst also scopes and drives smaller enhancement requests — translating business needs into clear requirements — while communicating effectively with business users, technical teams, and other stakeholders to ensure their needs are fulfilled.
  
  
**Principal Accountabilities and % of time**
**Product Maintenance & Analytics (50%)**

* Supports existing enterprise analytics products (e.g., Power BI and Tableau) by responding to user inquiries and troubleshooting issues, investigating root cause and escalating to technical teams or platform specialists when required
* Independently makes complex manual updates based on incoming requests, applying sound judgment to optimize the product
* Runs periodic user surveys and forums to track satisfaction and identify areas for improvement
* Tracks and analyzes key metrics — including dashboards, usage, and adoption — summarizing insights and findings for stakeholders
* Tests routine updates and enhancements to validate functionality and ensure a user-friendly experience

**Manage Enhancement Requests (40%)**

* Elicits requirements on small-to-medium sized requests, working with users to translate use cases and pain points into underlying requirements and potential solutions
* Transforms these requests into actionable work via user stories, process flow diagrams, and other supporting documentation
* Works with appropriate technical teams and third parties to complete these items, prioritizing and communicating dependencies and tradeoffs with key stakeholders throughout

**Develop Domain Knowledge (10%)**

* Builds domain knowledge and a comprehensive understanding of relevant tools and platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Databricks or similar enterprise data platforms) to act more independently
* Stays up to date about emerging analytics technologies, including AI tools, to continuously improve ways of working

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to synthesize data, user feedback, and operational metrics into clear insights and recommended actions, and exhibit root-cause thinking
* Strong user support and troubleshooting skills; ability to respond to user inquiries, investigate issues, identify root causes, resolve where appropriate, and escalate effectively to technical teams or platform specialists
* Working knowledge of business intelligence and analytics concepts (e.g., dashboards/reporting, data access, user permissions, tool platform concepts, adoption, and common end-user workflows); familiarity with tools such as Power BI or Tableau; experience consuming data from Databricks or an enterprise data platform preferred
* Strong work management and organizational skills; ability to work from a backlog, coordinate multiple workstreams, track actions and dependencies, prioritize work, and communicate dependencies and tradeoff implications
* Ability to translate business needs into actionable requirements, including soliciting use cases, stakeholder requirements, and platform pain points
* Strong stakeholder communication skills; ability to work effectively with business users, technical teams, platform administrators, vendors, and product leadership
* Strong written communication and documentation skills, including product documentation, status updates, process materials, user guidance, and executive-ready summaries
* Curiosity and willingness to learn emerging analytics technologies; ability to quickly learn new tools and evaluate capabilities; experience incorporating AI tools into day-to-day operations preferred

**Experience**

* Experience supporting technology products, analytics platforms, or business systems, ideally in a product management, product operations, business analyst, or similar role. Experience with business intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau) and enterprise data platforms is preferred
* Experience with product maintenance and testing, including supporting routine updates and enhancements, validating functionality through testing, and assessing whether changes continue to meet user needs
* Experience working in a corporate environment
* Experience solving basic issues in software tools and turning findings into actionable next steps
* Experience supporting users or customers with clear and helpful communication.
* Experience with support platforms like ServiceNow is preferred

title: Linux Systems & Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Miimansa focuses on addressing inefficiencies in the medical research-practice-delivery information flow, especially those caused by high costs and limitations of prospective clinical trials. The organization combines expertise in clinical data-management workflows, life sciences research, and artificial intelligence to improve how clinical research is conducted and translated into practice. By designing robust data and infrastructure “vasculature” for clinical research, Miimansa aims to enable more efficient, scalable, and reliable health insights. Team members work at the intersection of technology and healthcare, contributing to solutions that can impact real-world patient outcomes.

**About the role:**

We are looking for a hands-on Linux Systems & Infrastructure Engineer to support the computing and data-processing needs of our AI and research teams.The role spans Ubuntu/Linux administration, on-premise and cloud infrastructure, GPU-enabled workstations, computational environments, and infrastructure automation. The ideal candidate is comfortable with the command line, independent troubleshooting, scripting, and practical problem-solving in a fast-moving startup.You will work closely with technical and research teams to set up, maintain, monitor, and improve our computing infrastructure and supporting tools.

Key responsibilities

1. Linux systems and servers

* Set up, configure, and maintain Ubuntu/Linux systems across on-premise and cloud environments.
* Manage users, permissions, groups, storage, SSH access, and security controls.
* Monitor system health, CPU, memory, GPU, and storage utilization.
* Troubleshoot Linux, networking, hardware, and software issues, and maintain system documentation.

2. Data and compute environments

* Set up and maintain Python environments, packages, dependencies, and tools for data processing and AI workloads.
* Support researchers and engineers running large-scale data-processing and GPU workloads.
* Automate routine administration, monitoring, and data-processing tasks using Bash, Python, or similar tools.

3. GPU and workstation infrastructure

* Evaluate and recommend CPU, GPU, RAM, storage, networking, power, and cooling configurations for AI/ML and data-intensive workloads.
* Support hardware procurement, installation, configuration, testing, and benchmarking.
* Monitor compute resources and improve their utilization.

4. Resource monitoring and automation

* Develop scripts and lightweight tools to track system health, resource utilization, and user activity.
* Implement practical controls for shared computing resources and user access.
* Automate monitoring reports and alerts where appropriate.

5. General infrastructure responsibilities

* Take ownership of problems spanning hardware, software, networking, and infrastructure.
* Establish practical IT and computing practices as the organization grows.
* Work independently with evolving requirements, prioritizing simple, effective solutions.

Required skills

* Strong practical experience administering Ubuntu/Linux systems and servers.
* Comfortable with the Linux command line and independent troubleshooting.
* Experience with Bash scripting; Python scripting is preferred.
* Hands-on knowledge of Linux users, permissions, SSH, processes, services, storage, and networking.
* Familiarity with Git and software environments and dependency management.
* Understanding of CPU, RAM, GPU, storage, and networking hardware.
* Experience setting up or maintaining servers, workstations, or compute environments.
* Ability to develop scripts for routine administration, monitoring, and automation.

Desirable experience

* NVIDIA GPUs, CUDA, and AI/ML compute infrastructure.
* Docker and containerized workloads.
* Cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Slurm or other workload and resource management systems.
* Monitoring tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.
* Networking and firewall configuration.
* Ansible or other configuration-management tools.
* Supporting data science, machine learning, or research computing environments.

What we value

* A hands-on, resourceful approach and the ability to solve problems independently.
* Willingness to work across hardware, Linux, networking, scripting, and applications.
* A strong sense of ownership, without being constrained by narrow role boundaries.
* Careful attention to security, access control, and data handling.
* Comfort with ambiguity and changing priorities in a startup environment.
* A preference for simple, reliable solutions over unnecessary complexity.

Requirements added:

• 2+ years of work experience with Linux

• Bachelor's Degree

As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. title: Consulting Engineer - Data Center
description:
**Senior Data Center Consulting Engineer for Americas Time Zone**
**Meet the Team**
The Customer Experience (CX) team is a group of extraordinary technical professionals dedicated to delivering a best-in-class customer experience. We tackle the toughest business challenges with network-centric solutions that accelerate customer success and loyalty. Our success is reflected in our outstanding financial results, industry recognition, and high employee satisfaction. As the face of Cisco, our CX teams are the primary drivers of digital transformation. Within CX, the Global CX Centers serve as the engine for this transformation, providing flexible, innovative, and highly technical resources to support customer engagements across all theaters. We act as a seamless delivery partner, ensuring our customers achieve their business goals through flawless execution.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Data Center Senior Consulting Engineer, You Will Provide Expert-level Technical Guidance And Delivery For Our Most High-profile Global Customers. You Will
  
  

* Design and implement cutting-edge Cisco technologies for the world’s largest and most complex networks.
* Analyze, monitor, and optimize network performance while automating repeatable tasks.
* Apply innovative technology to solve real-world business problems and deliver scalable, robust services.
* Develop software and tools to automate manual processes and support infrastructure platforms.

* Conduct internal and external systems/product training and contribute to the development of intellectual property.

* Innovate within our service strategy to create new service capabilities and lead service delivery models.

**Minimum Qualifications**

title: Integrated Logistics Customer Onboarding Solution Lead
description:
**It's more than a job**
As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. And by transporting medicines, toys and important machine parts, you are not only delivering goods, you are making small and big moments possible for people all around the world. At Kuehne+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.
  
  
‎
  
  
Leads the assessment and integration of customer system processes for seamless 4PL onboarding, aligning configurations with business goals while minimizing complexity. Skilled in ERP/TMS platforms and stakeholder engagement, this role ensures standardized, blueprint-driven solutions, proactive troubleshooting, and precise documentation to support a smooth go-live experience.
  
  
**How you create impact**

* Conduct in-depth assessments of customer system processes to evaluate their compatibility with the 4PL logistics framework.
* Define and optimize data flows and system configurations to ensure efficient, low-complexity onboarding that aligns with business objectives.
* Work closely with the Onboarding Process Engineers to ensure the processes are well supported by IT systems.
* Evaluate trade-offs between customization and blueprint enhancements through deep knowledge of system architecture.
* Make informed decisions to balance customer requirements with standardized system capabilities, minimizing unnecessary complexity.
* Engage customers with clear, persuasive communication to promote standard integrations and discourage inefficient custom solutions.
* Align onboarding activities with internal best practices and standardized blueprints to uphold system efficiency and integrity.
* Demonstrate hands-on experience with TMS and ERP systems.
* Possess strong working knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP ECC and SAP S/4 HANA, with emphasis on logistics-related modules and configuration.
* Identify onboarding risks early and respond with effective troubleshooting and real-time mitigation strategies.
* Adjust system setups dynamically to enhance customer satisfaction and streamline the onboarding process.
* Maintain rigorous attention to detail in documenting onboarding configurations and processes.
* Ensure completeness and accuracy of system setup through validation and testing prior to go-live, minimizing error rates and reducing rework.
* Collaborate closely with internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure a smooth onboarding experience and timely decision-making.

**What we would like you to bring**

* Proven experience in ERP or TMS implementations.
* Background in IT project management or solution architecture.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills to articulate technical and operational concepts effectively.
* Excellent problem-solving abilities with a proactive approach to identifying and addressing potential challenges.
* Detail-oriented mindset with a meticulous approach to documentation and process configuration.
* Ability to critically assess and optimize customer requirements for long-term success.
* Experience in leading client workshops and coordinating across multiple teams.

**What's in it for you**
At Kuehne+Nagel, you’ll be part of a global logistics leader that believes in creating real impact on business, on customers, and on careers. Here’s what you can look forward to:
  
  

* Global Exposure: Step into a world of international opportunities with a presence in 100+ countries.
* People-Centric Culture: Join a team where your voice matters and people genuinely care.
* Learning & Development: Grow with us personally and professionally through world-class training and career pathways.
* Innovation & Sustainability: Be part of a future-focused company driving real change in logistics and the planet.
* Rewards & Recognition: Get rewarded for your passion, performance, and potential.
* Stability with Agility: Enjoy the best of both worlds a trusted global brand with a startup spirit.

**Who we are**
Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
  
  
As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

title: SOC Analyst
description:
**Bravura’s Commitment and Mission**
At Bravura Solutions, collaboration, diversity and excellence matter. We value your ideas, giving you room to be curious and innovate in an exciting, fast-paced, and flexible environment. We look for many different skills and abilities, as well as how you can add value to Bravura and our culture.
  
  
As a Global FinTech market leader and ASX listed company, Bravura is a trusted partner to over 350 leading financial services clients, delivering wealth management technology and products. We invest significantly in our technology hubs and innovation labs, which inspire and drive our creative, future-focused mindset. We take pride in developing cutting-edge, digital first technology solutions that support our clients to achieve financial security and prosperity for their customers.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Security Operations Analyst will support build out of our internal capability and partner closely with our outsourced SOC provider. This role focuses on incident response coordination, security monitoring, vulnerability management and remediation oversight, helping to strengthen our overall security posture through effective operational processes and active stakeholder collaboration.
  
  
You’ll play a vital role in ensuring we meet both our internal security obligations and the high expectations of our financial services clients.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Act as the in-house lead for escalations from our third-party MDR/SOC, supporting triage, investigation of alerts from the SIEM, EDR and cloud security tooling (Rapid7 InsightIDR, AWS GuardDuty/CloudTrail), and coordination of incident response
* Investigate security alerts across endpoint, identity, network and cloud environments, correlating available evidence to determine severity, business impact and appropriate response actions.
* Analyse Windows and identity-related security events, including Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Kerberos and NTLM authentication activity, and coordinate investigation and remediation with relevant technical teams.
* Review network security events involving TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, proxies, VPNs and common enterprise protocols, identifying suspicious behaviour and recommending appropriate follow-up actions.
* Escalate confirmed or complex incidents to the Senior SOC Analyst and the Rapid7 SOC. Support containment and recovery activities
* Document incidents from detection to closure in the ticketing system (Jira/ServiceNow)
* Follow established SOC runbooks and playbooks while contributing to the development, maintenance and continuous improvement of incident response runbooks, playbooks and standard operating procedures (SOPs)
* Support the vulnerability management programme such as scan scheduling, triage, risk prioritisation, and remediation tracking
* Monitor the threat landscape to inform detection and response activities
* Support audits and client due diligence processes where required

**Unleash your potential**
To be successful in this role, your background and experience will include:
  
  
  

* 3–5 years’ experience in a security operation, incident response, or SOC analyst role (in-house or MSSP/MDR)
* Hands-on experience with an enterprise SIEM. Rapid7 InsightIDR / InsightVM preferred; Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar or equivalent accepted)
* Working knowledge of network security fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, proxies, VPNs and common protocols.
* Practical experience investigating security events in Microsoft Windows environments, with working knowledge of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Kerberos, NTLM and common authentication flows.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear incident summaries, document evidence, and coordinate actions with infrastructure, application, engineering, and third-party SOC teams.
* Solid understanding of vulnerability management tools and risk-based remediation.
* Familiarity with regulatory and client security expectations in financial services or highly regulated environments
* Knowledge of attack techniques and incident response frameworks (e.g. MITRE ATT&CK)
* Beneficial:

+ scripting/automation, cloud security experience (AWS/Azure).
+ experience using approved AI-assisted security tools for alert triage, investigation, SIEM query development and reporting, with the ability to validate AI-generated outputs and handle sensitive security data appropriately.
+ Industry security certifications are a bonus.

**Working at Bravura**
Our people are the heart of our business. We work hard to provide a rich employee with experience and a robust framework for ongoing career development.
  
  
  

* Competitive salary and employee benefits scheme.
* Flexible working hours, we value work-life balance.
* Maternity/ Parental (including secondary) leave policy.
* A cab facility is available in Delhi/NCR.
* Meal facility available
* Free Medical Insurance

**Corporate Responsibilities Environmental & Health & Safety**

* Ensure Annual Training is competed as required.
* Review Annually & Comply with all Company policies related to H&S and Environmental Management Systems
* Report all/any breaches or accidents/near misses immediately when discovered.

**So, what’s next?**
We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion so even if you don’t match every listed skill or tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you.
  
  
Please note that interviews are primarily conducted virtually and if you require any reasonable adjustments or would like to note which pronouns you use, please let us know.
  
  
All final applicants for this position will be asked to consent to a criminal record and background check. Please note that people with criminal records are not automatically barred from applying for this position. Each application will be considered on its merits.

* Own Production Support delivery for your region from the India Hub—across platforms, teams, and priorities.
* Set a consistent, ITIL-aligned approach to incident, problem, and change management to protect stability and customer outcomes.
* Track and improve service performance through clear ownership of SLAs, KPIs, incident trends, and operational health.
* Balance demand, capacity, and cost—driving smarter planning, prioritization, and productivity.

* Ensure the right skill mix and shift coverage to meet regional demand—without compromising quality or wellbeing.

* Drive service reviews and governance forums, ensuring expectations match delivery and supporting effective decisions.

description:
**Description**
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
Amazon has built a global reputation for being the most customer-centric company, a company that customers from all over the world recognize, value, and trust for both our products and services. Amazon has a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun and Make History.”
  
  
As an increasing number of enterprises move their critical systems to the cloud, AWS India is in need of highly efficient technical consulting talent to help our largest and strategically important customers navigate the operational challenges and complexities of AWS Cloud. We are looking for Technical Consultants to support our customers creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application services, Networking, Server-less and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor for organizations ranging from start-ups to large enterprises.
  
  
As a Technical Account Manager, you will be the primary technical point of contact for one or more customers helping to plan, debug, and oversee ongoing operations of business-critical applications. You will get your hands dirty, troubleshooting application, network, database, and architectural challenges using a suite of internal AWS Cloud tools as well as your existing knowledge and toolkits. We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in I.T. Consulting and in any of these related areas such as Solution Designing, Application and System Development, Database Management, Big Data and Analytics, DevOps Consulting, and Media technologies. Knowledge of programming and scripting is beneficial to the role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:
  
  

* Learn and use Cloud technologies.
* Interact with leading technologists around the world.
* Work on critical, highly complex customer problems that may span multiple AWS Cloud services.
* Apply advanced troubleshooting techniques to provide unique solutions to our customers' individual needs.
* Work directly with AWS Cloud subject matter experts to help reproduce and resolve customer issues.
* Write tutorials, how-to videos, and other technical articles for the customer community.
* Leverage your extensive customer support experience and provide feedback to internal AISPL teams on how to improve our services.
* Drive projects that improve support-related processes and our customers’ technical support experience.
* Assist in Design/Architecture of AWS and Hybrid cloud solutions.
* Help Enterprises define IT and business processes that work well with cloud deployments.
* Be available outside of business hours to help coordinate the handling of urgent issues as needed.

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* 7+ years of hands-on infrastructure, troubleshooting, systems administration, networking, DevOps or applications development experience
* Experience in external enterprise customer-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Be mobile and travel to client locations as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead

Take ownership of the deployment timeline, proactively managing and overcoming any customer hesitations or delays to ensure rapid time\-to\-value Translate Strategy to Security Policy: Convert customer business and security designs into practical, effective PAB configurations, focusing on access controls, data loss prevention (DLP) rules, and web security policies Drive Adoption: Guide customers through the secure and large\-scale deployment of the PAB extension/client to end\-user devices using various enterprise deployment methods (e.g., GPO, MDM) Be a Proactive Technical Advisor: Serve as the go\-to expert for PAB best practices, advanced feature utilization, and performance tuning, actively monitoring environments to pre\-emptively identify, recommend, and resolve potential issues or areas for security posture improvement Resolve Complex Escalations: Act as the primary technical escalation point, performing deep\-dive root cause analysis and coordinating across Support, Engineering, and Product teams for timely resolution Document and Transfer Knowledge: Create high\-quality, customer\-specific "as\-built" documentation and deliver comprehensive operational training and knowledge transfer to customer administrators Advocate for the Customer: Capture and translate valuable field feedback into actionable feature requests, serving as a critical internal voice for product improvement and development Maintain expert\-level understanding of Prisma Access Browser: Stay updated on latest product releases, security trends, and industry best practices. Actively participate in relevant training and certification programs to maintain technical proficiency
   

  

**Qualifications (Additional Job Description)**
 Your Experience 8\+ years of experience required in a hands\-on, technical, customer\-facing role such as Professional Services Consultant, Technical Account Manager, or Senior Sales Engineer Proven track record of proactive engagement; the ability to take initiative to push customers toward successful deployment, manage project risks, and navigate organizational challenges or pushback to maintain project velocity Expert\-level knowledge of core networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S) and enterprise security principles (Zero Trust, SASE, Firewall, Proxy, VPN) Demonstrated ability to independently lead and execute complex technical projects in customer environments, driving deployment to successful completion Advanced analytical and troubleshooting skills with a methodical approach to identifying, diagnosing, and resolving technical issues (Root Cause Analysis) Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a proven ability to convey complex security topics to diverse technical and non\-technical stakeholders Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) and authentication protocols, specifically integrating solutions with IdPs like Azure AD or Okta using SAML 2\.0 Familiarity with cloud and SaaS security architecture and the challenges associated with securing modern applications and browsers Knowledge of Prisma Access deployment, architecture, and traffic flows These skills are desired and will be prioritized, accelerating time\-to\-value in the role: Basic knowledge of enterprise tools for large\-scale device deployment (e.g., Microsoft Intune, Jamf, SCCM) Industry certifications such as Palo Alto Networks (PCNSA, PCNSE), CISSP, or cloud\-specific security certifications Basic scripting ability (e.g., PowerShell, Python) for automation or data manipulation

title: Manager - IT, Security, and Cloud
description:
**5–7 Years \| Gurgaon \| Full\-Time**
**Company:** 
 iDream Education
   

  

**Location:** 
 Sector 32, Gurgaon
   

  

**Role type:** 
 Full\-time, Work from Office
   

  

**Experience:** 
 5–7 years of direct and relevant experience with end\-to\-end ownership of IT infrastructure, security, and operations
   

  

**Industry Preference:** 
 EdTech, Education SaaS, Social Impact / Development Sector, or purpose\-led B2B/B2G organisations
   

  

* About iDream Education


**Vision:** 
 Unlimited Learning. Unlimited Growth. For Everyone.
   

  

**Belief:** 
 We believe that access to learning and growth is a fundamental right, and that learning in its truest sense is the joyful unfolding of a being's fullest potential — in all dimensions of life.
   

  

**Mission:** 
 To deliver solutions and experiences that facilitate access to learning and growth for everyone, irrespective of their languages, geographies, abilities, curricula, age groups, learning styles, and socio\-economic status.
   

  

**Education**
 iPrep by iDream Education is a Learning Platform that runs both offline \& online, is bilingual and works on all major hardware devices and operating systems. iPrep delivers curriculum\-aligned digital learning for classes 1st to 12th in English, Hindi, and Regional language mediums for universal reach and learning use as:
   

  

* iPrep Digital Class for Smart Classrooms
* iPrep Digital Library for Tablets/Notebooks based Smart ICT Labs
* iPrep PAL for Personalised Adaptive Learning
* iPrep Tablets for Preloaded Learning Devices with Monitoring
* iPrep App for a one\-stop learning platform across Android, iOS, and Web


 Through iPrep, iDream Education empowers teachers and students, both in schools and at home to
 **Learn Unlimited** 
 .
   

  

 Company website:
 **www.idreameducation.org**
 iPrep website:
 **www.iprep.in**
* Role Summary


 We are looking for an IT Lead — someone who will be the single point of ownership for everything IT at iDream Education. This is not a narrow infrastructure or helpdesk role; it is a domain\-ownership role spanning internal systems, network and cloud infrastructure, our field\-deployed device fleet (iPrep Tablets and other hardware), data security, and compliance.
   

  

 You will be the person who ensures our internal teams never lose a working day to IT friction, and who ensures thousands of devices deployed across schools and NGOs in rural India stay secure, tracked, and functional. You will also be the one building the IT function itself — starting hands\-on, and growing it into a proper team as iDream scales.
   

  

* Key Responsibilities \& Deliverables


**IT Infrastructure, Systems \& Support**
* Own and manage all internal IT infrastructure — networks, servers, cloud services, and systems administration — ensuring uptime, reliability, and security across office operations.
* Run IT helpdesk and support for all employees, ensuring fast turnaround on hardware, software, and access\-related issues.
* Own vendor relationships for hardware, software licenses, ISPs, cloud providers, and AMC contracts — negotiating terms, managing renewals, and controlling IT spend.


**Device \& Field Hardware Fleet Management**
* Own the full lifecycle of iPrep Tablets and other field\-deployed hardware — procurement, provisioning, tracking, maintenance, and end\-of\-life — across schools and NGO locations.
* Build and maintain systems for remote monitoring, troubleshooting, and updates of devices deployed at scale in low\-connectivity environments.
* Coordinate with product and tech teams to ensure hardware compatibility with new iPrep software releases and rollouts.


**Data Security \& Compliance**
* Own information security practices across the organisation — access controls, data backup, endpoint security, and incident response.
* Ensure the organisation's data handling practices align with DPDPA 2023 and other applicable data protection requirements.
* Conduct periodic security audits and risk assessments, and build/maintain IT policies, SOPs, and documentation.


**AI\-First IT Operations:** 
 Bring AI\-augmented workflows into IT operations — from automated monitoring and alerting to AI\-assisted troubleshooting, documentation, and reporting — keeping iDream's IT stack modern and lean.
   

  

* Qualifications \& Experience


**Experience:** 
 5–7 years in IT infrastructure, systems administration, or IT operations, with demonstrable ownership across networks, hardware/device management, and security — ideally including experience managing hardware deployed outside a single office (field, retail, or distributed environments).
   

  

**Sector Context:** 
 Experience in EdTech, the Development sector, or mission\-driven B2B/B2G environments is a strong advantage. Experience managing device fleets in low\-bandwidth or rural contexts is a plus.
   

  

**Technical Proficiency:** 
 Strong grounding in networking, systems administration (Windows/Linux), cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), and device/MDM (mobile device management) tools.
   

  

**Security \& Compliance:** 
 Working knowledge of IT security fundamentals and data protection principles, including familiarity with DPDPA 2023\.
   

  

**Vendor \& Budget Management:** 
 Proven experience managing vendor contracts, AMC negotiations, and IT budgets.
   

  

**AI Fluency:** 
 You use AI tools as a daily productivity layer for monitoring, troubleshooting, documentation, and reporting — not as a novelty.
   

  

* Key Skills \& Competencies


**What Makes You a Great Fit?**
 You think in systems, not tickets. You've owned IT for an organisation before — not just responded to issues as they came in — and you know how to build infrastructure and processes that scale without breaking. You're equally comfortable troubleshooting a server issue and thinking through how thousands of tablets in rural India stay secure and functional. You're excited about using AI to make IT operations faster and leaner, and you've already started building that into how you work.
   

  

* What We're Looking For — Values \& Culture Fit
* Integrity: Takes ownership of IT infrastructure, security, compliance, and data protection with transparency, accountability, and strong ethical standards.
* Excellence: Builds reliable, secure, scalable, and AI\-enabled IT systems while continuously improving infrastructure, processes, and support.
* Collaboration: Works effectively with internal teams, vendors, and technology partners to ensure seamless IT operations and successful hardware and system deployments.
* Impact: Enables uninterrupted business operations and ensures secure, reliable technology reaches teams, schools, and last\-mile learners at scale.
* Why Join Us


 We are on a mission to take the best of digital learning to every corner of rural Bharat. At iDream, you will have the opportunity to build and own the IT function from the ground up — one that keeps our teams productive and our technology reaching the last\-mile learner securely and reliably.
   

  

* Required Skills (Portal Tags)


 Network Administration, Systems Administration, Cloud Infrastructure, IT Security, Device/MDM Management, Vendor Management, Data Protection Compliance, Decision Making, Analytical Skills

title: Exchange Online Administrator

Our Company
   

  

 We're Hitachi Digital, a company at the forefront of digital transformation and the fastest growing division of Hitachi Group. We're crucial to the company's strategy and ambition to become a premier global player in the massive and fast\-moving digital transformation market.
   

  

 Our group companies, including GlobalLogic, Hitachi Digital Services, Hitachi Vantara and more, offer comprehensive services that span the entire digital lifecycle, from initial idea to full\-scale operation and the infrastructure to run it on. Hitachi Digital represents One Hitachi, integrating domain knowledge and digital capabilities, and harnessing the power of the entire portfolio of services, technologies, and partnerships, to accelerate synergy creation and make real\-world impact for our customers and society as a whole.
   

  

 Imagine the sheer breadth of talent it takes to unleash a digital future. We don't expect you to 'fit' every requirement – your life experience, character, perspective, and passion for achieving great things in the world are equally as important to us.

* Design, deploy, and manage Exchange Online within Microsoft 365\.
* Administer, configure, and maintain Exchange Online services.
* Handle mailbox management, permissions, and troubleshooting.
* Manage mail flow, connectors, and transport rules.
* Configure anti\-spam, anti\-malware, and phishing protection policies.
* Implement and manage retention policies, legal holds, and eDiscovery.
* Perform advanced message tracing and diagnostics
* Maintain and support Teams environment including channels, permissions, and policies.
* Configure Teams governance and compliance settings.
* Administer OneDrive for Business and provide support for SharePoint Online (nice to have).
* Manage user accounts, permissions, and security configurations in Azure Active Directory
* Ensure compliance with organizational security and governance standards.


**What You’ll Bring**
* 8\+ years of experience in Microsoft 365 administration with strong focus on Exchange Online and Teams.
* Deep knowledge of mail flow, transport rules, and security policies.
* Hands\-on experience with Azure AD identity and access management.
* Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills for complex messaging environments.
* Familiarity with retention policies, legal holds, and eDiscovery processes.
* Experience in managing Teams governance and collaboration policies.
* Knowledge of OneDrive and SharePoint Online administration is a plus.


**Preferred Attributes**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and in cross\-functional teams.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills.
* Proven track record of managing enterprise\-scale Microsoft 365 environments.


**About Us**
 We're a global, 1000\-strong, diverse team of professional experts, promoting and delivering Social Innovation through our One Hitachi initiative (OT x IT x Product) and working on projects that have a real\-world impact. We're curious, passionate and empowered, blending our legacy of 110 years of innovation with our shaping our future.  We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit\-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.

We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. *We're proud to say we're an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status or any other protected characteristic.*

title: Salesforce Administrator
description:

Through recent strategic acquisitions, Numerix has further strengthened its leadership position, empowering financial institutions worldwide to transform risk into opportunity with confidence. As AI reshapes capital markets technology, Numerix is focused on combining the speed and flexibility of AI with the deterministic, auditable, and governed calculations that financial institutions require.
   

  

 The
 **Salesforce Administrator** 
 is responsible for the administration of the Numerix Salesforce.com org. Salesforce.com is our primary system of records for sales and service teams. As the Salesforce Administrator, you will configure, integrate, administer, train, and support end users on the Salesforce platform.
   

  

**What You'll Do:**
* Administer and maintain the Salesforce CRM platform, ensuring smooth day\-to\-day operations.
* Manage and configure Salesforce CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) applications to streamline sales processes.
* Manage user accounts, create and update \- profiles, validation rules, flows, process builders, reports and dashboards in Salesforce.
* Establish or adjust assignment rules, escalation rules, auto response rules, queues, fields, objects and formulas by closely collaborating with stakeholders such as sales, service and marketing teams.
* Participate in the discovery of data from various internal sources and the creation of reports and dashboards.
* Troubleshoot and resolve Salesforce platform issues, working closely with stakeholders.
* Perform data quality checks and data cleansing tasks to ensure accurate records.
* Support and maintain integration between Salesforce and other business systems.
* Train and support end users on new or existing internal and third\-party software systems and processes.
* Conduct appropriate analysis of existing Salesforce data to help identify patterns and aid in data quality improvements.
* Research and recommend third\-party applications to enhance the operational efficiency of business users on the Salesforce platform.
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and IT teams to understand business requirements and implement tailored solutions.
* Monitor Salesforce releases and apply new features to keep the system updated.
* Provide recommendations for process improvements based on analysis of Salesforce data.


**What We're Looking for:**
* BS in Computer Science or Information Technology.
* 3\+ years’ experience in Salesforce CRM and CPQ administration. Salesforce Certified Administrator (ADM 201\) certification is mandatory.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce CPQ, including product rules, pricing, quoting, and discounting structures.
* Experience in Salesforce platform customization and configuration, working with platform objects, fields and layouts.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce CPQ, including product rules, pricing, quoting, and discounting structures.
* Experience in re\-engineering or updating an existing Salesforce org.
* Basic data science skills with proficiency in building reports and dashboards for business users.
* Ability to make independent decisions and assist in developing creative solutions to support business strategies.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with proven ability to gather and decipher information from business users.
* Experience preparing and delivering training to staff.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills to collaborate with cross\-functional teams.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Adhere to work timings: 1:30PM – 10:30PM IST (Indian Standard Hours).


**Extra Credit:**
* Salesforce CPQ Specialist Certification.
* 100 Trailhead Badges and multiple Superbadges.
* Exposure to Data Visualization tools like PowerBI/Tableau.
* Familiarity with Apex and Visualforce (basic understanding).
* Experience with third\-party Salesforce integrations and tools.
* Experience in user training and documentation.
* Strong interest in pursuing other SF certs.


**Where you'll work:**
 This is a remote role, open to all who reside within India.
   

  

**An important note on language:**
 We will only consider CVs written in English. All interviews will be conducted in English, and candidates must demonstrate business fluency in the language.
   

  

**An important note on salary:**
 The annual pay range for this position is based on the preferred primary location of the role which is listed above. If you are applying to this role at a location that is not the preferred primary location, please keep in mind the salary range will vary and may fall outside of what is listed. Base pay offered may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

title: Client Services and Administration

Company Description
 



 Synergetic Communication Inc. is a debt collection agency focused on combining a customer\-centric approach with advanced technology to achieve effective delinquent account recovery. The company emphasizes innovation, using modern tools and streamlined processes to improve efficiency, transparency, and communication. Its compliance\-driven operations aim to foster trust and satisfaction among both clients and consumers. Team members are expected to balance strong results with respectful, empathetic interactions. Synergetic Communication Inc. is committed to redefining industry standards by aligning technology, communication, and positive consumer experiences.
 



  





 Role Description
 



 We are expanding our Client Services and Administration team with multiple full\-time, on\-site openings based in Gurugram, India. This team is the operational and compliance backbone of the business, supporting consumer interactions, data integrity, training delivery, quality assurance, audit readiness, and platform uptime. Candidates are encouraged to apply once and indicate in their application which function best matches their experience; we will consider applicants across all openings.
 



  





 Open Functions
 



  





 Consumer Disputes \- Research, document, and resolve consumer disputes end to end. Review account histories, gather supporting documentation, prepare written responses within regulatory timeframes, and escalate issues that require compliance or legal review.
 



  





 Data Entry \- Accurately enter, validate, and maintain account and consumer records across internal platforms. Reconcile incoming client files, correct data discrepancies, and maintain the record quality that downstream reporting and compliance depend on.
 



  





 Learning Management System Admin (LMS) \- Administer the company learning platform: build and publish courses, manage user accounts and permissions, assign and track required compliance training, troubleshoot learner issues, and report on completion rates and certification status.
 



  





 Quality Call Scoring \- Monitor and score recorded consumer calls against quality and compliance scorecards. Document findings, identify coaching opportunities and trends, and partner with operations leadership to raise consistency across the floor.
 



  





 Internal Audit Testwork \- Execute internal audit test procedures across operational and compliance controls. Pull and review samples, document evidence and exceptions, prepare clear workpapers, and support remediation tracking through to closure.
 



  





 System Monitoring Admin \- Monitor production systems, dialer platforms, and scheduled processes for availability and errors. Track alerts, run daily health checks, log and escalate incidents, and maintain monitoring documentation and shift handoff notes.
 



  





 Qualifications
 


* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to document work clearly and professionally.
* Solid computer proficiency, including Microsoft Excel and Word, and comfort learning new business platforms quickly.
* High attention to detail and accuracy when working with records, documentation, and consumer data.
* Ability to follow defined procedures, meet deadlines, and work within a regulated, compliance\-focused environment.
* Sound judgment in handling confidential and sensitive consumer information.
* Ability to work on\-site in Gurugram, India, on assigned shifts, and to collaborate with operations, compliance, and management teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Prior experience in BPO, collections, financial services, customer service, quality assurance, audit, or systems administration is an advantage.
* Function\-specific experience is preferred but not required: dispute handling or complaints for Consumer Disputes; high\-volume data processing for Data Entry; LMS or training coordination for LMS Admin; QA scorecards or call monitoring for Quality Call Scoring; audit or controls testing for Internal Audit Testwork; monitoring tools, ticketing, or basic SQL for System Monitoring Admin.



 Please indicate your preferred function or functions in your application.

**Job Description**
 The Customer Engagement Network is a dedicated team of Customer Care Professionals, leaders and support groups working together to deliver outstanding service every day to our Card Members around the world. Our dedicated care professionals and partners strive to treat every servicing interaction as an opportunity to put the customer first, add meaningful value, and deepen relationships.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Consistently deliver extraordinary service (through chat or phone, as required,) whilst in a fast\-paced, structured, customer care environment.
* Able to address 2\-3 Chat conversations simultaneously.
* Consult with Card Members to understand their needs and tailor unique and personal solutions for them, while also reinforcing the benefits of card membership that deepen customer engagement.
* Develop key consulting skills, including building a human connection with customers through care and empathy, handling objections, and providing solutions.
* Meet and exceed performance goals that include customer satisfaction, consultative sales, handling time, schedule adherence, and compliance regulations.
* Maintain a high level of integrity to work with customer information and meet compliance requirements.


**Qualifications**
**Minimum Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree
* Not more than 5 years of difference between highest education degree completion date and Joining date
* Should not have enrolled in any prior Government Apprenticeship programs
* Computer literate, able to navigate through multiple computer systems and applications, simultaneously, with speed and accuracy.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to be able to converse clearly and naturally, while demonstrating active listening skills to adapt conversation to suit the situation and the Card Member’s communication style.
* A problem\-solver to efficiently evaluate Card Member issues and offer the best inventive solutions with a view to resolving on the first contact.
* Proven analytical skills to analyse customer accounts, uncover the root cause of customer issues and provide tailored solutions to customer satisfaction
* Resilience is needed to efficiently manage a steady stream of customer interactions, while balancing performance to meet a variety of metrics.
* Ability to multitask and answer multiple Card Member queries simultaneously, while toggling between screens/tools, without becoming overwhelmed


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Strong written and communication skills to be able to converse effectively and naturally with our Card Members to deepen client relationships and drive satisfaction.
* Resilience needed to efficiently manage a steady stream of customer chats, while balancing performance to meet a variety of metrics and remain positive through change and stressful situations.
* Ability to showcase humility and show care and appreciation through emotional acknowledgement of our customer queries/situations on each chat.
* Technical savvy to multi\-task and navigate through multiple computer systems and applications, simultaneously, with speed and accuracy.
* Integrity to manage sensitive Card Member information and adhere to all Regulatory and Compliance guidelines related to servicing practices.
* Timeliness and reliability.


**Additional Requirements**
* Flexibility to work anytime in US hours (24\*7 rotational shifts), including weekends.
* Hybrid Environment\- on site expectation 3 days/week.
* Workplace Flexibility: Full time. Shift flexibility requirements.
* American Express offers a fantastic and diverse working environment.


**Compliance Language**
 At American Express, Our Culture Is Built On a 175\-year History Of Innovation, Shared Values And Leadership Behaviors, And An Unwavering Commitment To Back Our Customers, Communities And Colleagues. As Part Of Team Amex, You’ll Experience This Powerful Backing
   

  

* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Career development and training opportunities


**About Us**
 At American Express, our culture is built on a 175\-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world\-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
   

  

 As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well\-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
